OK, it's 7:39 am and  I just got my caffeine fix decided to try brooklawn, it's in a big shop center where I am joining a gym starting my new year's resolution early. The place clean , moves fast and my salted caramel coffee is perfect. Luv my flavored coffees at DD. Def, try the waffle sandwich egg, cheese its very good but I am trying to cut down on carbs and it's hard but def the waffle breakfast sandwich was worth it . Def glad I stopped by and bought a thermal stainless for keeping my coffee hot!; They do a big drive in business , huge line as I pulled up. Coffee hot and keeping me warm with the very windy chilly morning it's starting out , hope it warms up a bit. def a warm weather girl at heart. check out my new  thermal cup. !!!

This is a lovely hotel but be careful not to leave anything in your car or your bikes on your vehicle. We had 2 locked bikes stolen off our van and the hotel could not help us at all - they have no cameras in the parking lot. All they needed was one camera monitoring the entrance to the lot since there is only one way in and out - it would of been a great help to us. The room we had was small and nowhere to put the bikes. A locked bike storage area for guests would be a great ammenity to this hotel. What would of been a lovely stay turned into a nightmare for us. We spent our vacation driving around looking for bike thieves.

I'm surprised that this theatre only has three stars. Whenever I'm wanting to see a movie this is definitely the theatre I always come to. 
The theatre rooms inside are large and spacious. The seating is very comfortable and has a nice recline. 
Don't worry about being able to hear movies from the other rooms because the walls are thick and sound proof. 
Every time I've been here the staff has been courteous and I've never had a bad experience with the employees, most are eager to help and answer questions. 

There is also a bar inside the theatre which is also a win, However I have never personally been to the bar. I prefer the Coke freestyle machine during my movie experience. This theatre is also filled to the brim with all types of movie concession food and snacks so you don't get hungry, but the prices are typical for a movie theatre. 

They also have an IMAX theatre which is great, as I've been to see two IMAX productions and enjoyed them thoroughly. 

I will continue to go to this theatre every time!
Meaning of the only problem here is that their french fries are soggy and undercooked
The staff is wonderful, the coffee is great, and the concept is different. An Indonesian cafe right in the heart of fishtown!

I would eat here again, but mostly because it is an interesting destination in a town with a lot of bad restaurants. Great decor, noisy atmosphere, and funky vibe. Servers seem hip, but we were rushed through an inattentive service. (One of those dinners where you better ask for the check when you can because you don't know when you will see the waiter again). Note to Gluten Free folks, this place is not completely safe or knowledgeable and the GF buns were awful. The house catsup, which is apparently a thing here, is not GF. Note to anyone with a car: parking sucks.
Great ambiance, great food, fantastic cocktail. Next rime we'll try some of the regional craft beers on tap! Definitely cool place to watch a game. Our bartender Ashley was amazing.

Probably the most expensive game in town. But totally worth it for me. I upgraded myself to the executive locker rooms because that gives me zero excuses for why I can't go to the gym before work or after if I am going out later that night. I always have my makeup, hair stuff, etc in my locker. Just getting back to the gym after a long absence due to health issues so I'm taking it slow. I've seen one or two machines that are not quite working right but the facility as a whole is pretty sharp & welcoming. You have tons of options of what to do classes wise, equipment wise...
My only 2 down sides are that I wish they were open a little later on weekends, but that's just me moving slowly on my time off. I wish there was a bit more ritation with the class schedule. There are classes I'd like to take but they always run mid day, never really early, after work or weekends. So no option to try them. I'm sure it's an instructor issue so not likely something that will change. Overall I'm super happy that I joined.

I was in the area today and decided to get my gyro fix. For two gyros it was just under 19 bucks. My wife and I were less than impressed. The gyros were noticeably smaller and less tasty than before. For 19 bucks, I'll look for a new gyro place.

Nice sit-down pizza spot in the Loop area, near Washington University. We went on a Friday night, so they were fairly busy and sat outside. Service was friendly, but not as attentive as one might hope.

Pizza was very good...we had two types of pizza. Ingredients seemed fresh, and the crust was nice and chewy. It seems like a small would be enough for two....they recommended a large, but we only ate about half of it.

The inside seemed very loud...we were glad to be sitting outside.

Overall, a nice spot for pizza.
big store, lots of stuff, a little disheveled ( im not sure if thats a word, but it fits). They did have a lot of stuff on clearance so there are probably deals to be had.

I love Henpeck on Sundays! Their brunch is SO good! You can get any type of omelette and the buffet is a little different every weekend. I'm trying to watch my weight so I get an egg white omelette with veggies. The guys do a great job cooking them and the vegetable dishes are very tastefully done and the desserts are good as well. I splurge sometimes and get a dessert from time to time. My favorite is the banana pudding. Delicious!!

There are many, MANY reasons that this place is beyond amazing, but here are my top 3...

1.  They still sell milk in glass bottles that you bring back to them when you're empty.

2.  Good god their chocolate milke is the creamiest, thickest, fattiest, most delicious you will ever taste.

3.  They are one of the very few places that sell Cherry Ski.  Oh Cherry Ski, I miss you!

Love the ease of scheduling online and the fact that you get a free service as a first time customer.  I saw Sarah last week for brow and lip wax and she did an excellent job.  I appreciated that she explained their process and the products they use.  She took the extra time to shape and fill in my brows with powder and pencil, and they looked excellent when I left.  I'll definitely go back and like that they are open on weekends.

Great place to start the day. Really good food and great service. Got here relatively early and were seated right away. Our service was fantastic and they were great with kids. We had a couple of omelettes and French toast and the food was fantastic. The entire staff was very friendly and accommodating. I Would definitely recommend this to anyone visiting or in New Orleans.

Ok...... ALL DELISH! We had the fish and chips that were seasoned and battered just right. The fish tacos were as well perfect. Even the chicken sandwich was done right! The tuna sandwich was delish!
The outside garden with the ocean and beach view is breathe taking! Sandy play area for kids and adult area with firepit!

I was overall satisfied. However, the car was not clean on the exterior. It had bugs smashed all over the front bumper and on the windshield where the wipers dont reach. However, that is not why I was disappointed. I reserved on hotwire and thrifty was the least expensive by a few dollars. Well, when I arrived to pick up the car, I was told I couldnt drive it to Texas as it isnt in the allowable area. I was told I would have to pay an extra $20 a day for that option. The rental clerk dropped it to $10 a day as a "courtesy." I rent cars several times a year for long trips. In the past I have used Budget and Enterprise and never had to deal with this. 

I would have refused the rental if I hadnt been on tight schedule. 

I will not use Thrifty again as this hidden charge made the rental the most expensive instead of the least expensive. 

Only reason I didnt drop my rating to one star is that the car had no problems and the rental agent was polite and courteous.
Very small and casual. Counter walk up with sit down and take out options. Fast, kind service. If you are looking for solid, quick, cheap bibimbap, this is the place for you!

Where to even begin. A group of 8 of us reserved a table and bottle service for my cousins birthday. We arrived before 11pm, as requested by Managment so we didn't have to pay the cover fee. We arrived at 10:45pm, the place was dead but we were seated at our table immediately. After 20 minutes of waiting at our table, a waitress (Annie) finally greeted us and we ordered 3 bottles to start. After our bottles came out the waitresses immediately walked away. Never once offering to pour our drinks, ask how things were going etc. This was a red flag but we gave her the benefit of the doubt. An hour and a half later, still no sign of our waitress or any other staff member. Not one person came over to see how things were going since they brought our bottles and mixers out. At this point, we were out of ice, mixers and were pretty disappointed in the customer service we had received thus far. After having to go up to the bar twice to ask for our waitress (Annie) she finally came back to check on our table. Not only was she rude and short with us but she really set the tone for our disappointing experience. If we wanted to serve ourselves and have to go to the bar, we wouldn't of reserved table service. Instead, when we asked her for more mixers and ice, we were brushed off and made to feel like we were asking for too much. When our ice and mixers were finally replenished, they were flat. My cousin had to go up to the bar yet again and ask them to replace our mixers. We ending up closing our tab out shortly after this due to the worst customer service I've ever encountered and it basically ruined our night. It gets worse, I received an alert from my credit card company today that our waitress decided to give herself a $680.00 tip on my credit card and my cousins credit card was charged another $816 tip as well!!! Not only was it the worst customer service experience I've ever had but they fraudulently charged my cousin and I's credit cards hundreds of dollars. I'm completely disgusted and feel so violated by what should have been a wonderful celebration and a nice night out, turned into a nightmare. Don't trust this place or their rude, thieving employees! I would never recommend this establishment to anyone unless they want to be disrespected and robbed.

Disappointing meal.  Burgers were just okay - the pimento was better than the  woodstock, but neither would bring us back.  Both the kids meal and the adult plate's truffle fries were over cooked.  Sadly, the service was off as several other reviewers found.  Our server lost/forgot our appetizer, then brought that out at the same time as the burgers.  We then found that the items we asked to have  left off of the burger were not removed.

The restaurant is very kid friendly and offers some decent beers and cocktails.  Nice place, too.

My boyfriend has had a really hard time finding a good barber. After seeing Meister's in Philly Mag he decided to give it a try. He loved the atmosphere, prices are reasonable and his barber really took his time and made sure he was happy with his cut and shave. Free beer was also a bonus! I love the cuts he gets there and he'll definitely be going back.

Go here and get a burger.  Get the King Burger and the Village Whiskey Burger.  Also get some pickles and eat your face off.  I like going here and just stuffing my face and enjoying every minute of it.  From the duck fries to the deviled eggs - order, eat, and enjoy.  Just go and eat and savor.  Yeah your gonna pay but it is worth it.
Jambalaya, bbq shrimp appetizer, oysters!! All delicious!! Bread is freshly heated and super delicious. Location is central on Bourbon so you really feel the party atmosphere.

Came here with my friends for lunch and was really surprised. I felt a tad under dressed for how nice and elegant it was inside. We were seated and given plenty of time to look at the menu. The waiter was spot on, and generous. He kept on refilling our water and recommended certain things. 

I got the miso soup and scallion pancake and miso soup. The miso soup was very smooth and the tofu in it was tasty. It's been awhile since I had miso soup that good. Then I got sushi which consisted of: tamago, shrimp, crab, octopus, and salmon. It was very delicous and each bite was flavorful. The octopus seemed a tad tough but it was still delicous. Everything came in good portions. Well worth the $11.95. 

Then I had banana tempur for dessert. So many bananas. It was so yummy! The bananas didn't feel oily or heavy, they were delicous. Will definitely get them again, and it was big enough to share. 

$55 in total for everyone. It is certainly an experience. If I was more comfortable with money I would totally go here every week. This place seems like it'd be successful in New York. Reminded me of all the nice restaurants up there. Good job!

Came for happy hour before strolling to Bourbon street! Had the fried oysters for 1.25 each. Sooooo good! We also got the shrimp and grits, equally tasty! 

Half off all alcohol beverages during happy hour, which starts at 3pm! And 1.25 oysters either fried or cold. They are huge! 

Service was awesome! And the waiter sent us an extra drink, because ya know, why not! The place is a lil upscale and adjacent to the hotel. We got there just before the crowd started strolling in. Will be back next time I'm in NoLa!
This SAMs is great. We smear at the one in Murfreesboro regularly and the food and atmosphere is very good. Same here. Server Kristin was awesome.

I dare you to find a better bakery and cafe!   This is a locally owned establishment that knows how to take care of it's clientele!  The sandwiches are stuffed full of meat and veggies.  The bread is made in house and is so delicious.  The pastries and cookies are fabulous.  You have to try the Blueberry Bread and the Mountain cookie!  You will be back!   The owner, Patrick, is always on hand to make sure everything is perfect and that the service is fast and friendly.

Fantastic used record shop.  They moved all their vinyl downstairs but that somehow adds to its charm.   There's not a lot of "hard to find" things here but every time I go I do find something that I want downstairs.  

Their used CD selection is huge, but I've never really bought used CDs there.

This was a great place to have brunch with the family. It is very clean and the staff were great. I love the decor!! Plus, my four year old actually ate here!!! That is a HUGE deal. He doesn't like anything.

My brother is getting married today, so our family of 5 came in for a big breakfast. The wait staff was extremely pleasant and our waitress even dropped off a complementary cinnamon roll to the table in honor of my brother's big day! The omelets were well portioned, the eggs Benedict was delicious, and the breakfast burrito was big enough for two! I highly recommend this diner!!

Very nice restaurant! Interior looks very modern and comfortable. Staff was very attentive and friendly. Food was good, smaller plates, nice variety; a bit greasy, but tasty. Ambience was a bit loud. Overall a very good experience.

SO good! I was a little skeptical about making the drive out to Southampton, PA (never even heard of it) but wow, totally worth every ounce of gas. When I first got to my destination I almost passed it up because the outside was so inconspicuous and unassuming. It was literally just a white building with windows and their sign. Looking back I think they could totally do well with some outside beautification and possibly add some outdoor patio seating! :)

Anyway, upon entering, the place was actually rather cute inside and packed with people (always a good sign). The crowd was comprised mostly of young and middle aged people - no overly granola-type people or hipsters to be found in this vegetarian spot! Our server was nice and OMG the food was amazing. My friend and I split 2 entrees: the Koagie (or Korean hoagie, for those who are unfamiliar) and the Farmhouse Cubano sandwich. Both were served in really generous portions (neither of us could finish) and a side of greens. We happily ate our meal and talked over what ended up being 2 hours...mean while the restaurant never seemed to have more than one open table at a time; the customers kept on coming. Still, we were never rushed from our seats or made to feel like they needed the space. 

I would definitely return again!
Not bad. The proximity to the beach and other businesses on the main strip is nice, but I would put it in the category of average thai food. Not bad, but nothing that makes me do jumping jacks.

Was hungry for a great meal and a friend reminded me of this place.  Been way too long.  I got the chicken parm with meatballs.  It was amazing!  My friend got a pasta dish with hot Italian sausage.  That too was awesome.  Have to remember this place more often.

My family recently purchased a 2015 Mazda CX-5 from this dealership.  They had a large selection, and after looking over quite a few we made our choice.  The price was within our predetermined range, and the sales staff were not pushy at all.  We looked at other small SUVs, or Crossovers as they are called, around Reno and felt there was very little difference in the various makes.  We decided on the Mazda because of the Dolan's family's history of giving back to the community.  We couldn't be more pleased with the vehicle.
By far the best place in the northeast and not over price, great show, best hibachi I've even been to. The atmosphere is amazing and everyone is so welcoming. I alway try to go here any chance I get.
I thoroughly enjoyed the show.  Chill way to spend a Friday night.
Breakfast of powdered eggs, bacon melted through the styrofoam, no bread. Totally unsatisfying.

You are pleasantly surprised by this restaurant.  It looks like your average pub but it is so much more.  The menu is diverse with normal pub food like wings and burgers.  But they also have osso bucco and potato encrusted grouper.  I had the grouper and it was delicious.  Seared on the outside and moist and succulent on the inside.  My husband had the fish tacos.  They served 3 tacos with huge chunks of grilled mahi mahi.  He loved it. They have outdoor seating if you don't want to be part of the bar scene which is loud and noisy with lots of TVs going.  The outside overlooks a pond with a fountain.  Almost every night they have a $3.95 special.  That night it was meatloaf with mashed potatoes and gravy and a veggie.  My mom ordered it and she said it was killer delicious.  The only caveat is you have to order a drink with the special.  She had a decaf coffee so she was a cheap date that night.  But the prices on the menu are very reasonable and the amount of food is plentiful.  Last time we were there I had the house pasta with chicken.  It is done in a light cream sauce and is enough for at least two meals.  So good.

I have not been here in years, everybody who knows food in Tucson has either been here or at least heard about it.  My memory was the food was amazing but the atmosphere was a little too claustrophobic grandmas french parlor (reminded me of some old school places i went to in France and Belgium).  What I experienced this time was mouth watering, buttery rich satisfying impeccable dishes, as well as a cleaner more updated venue.  It was packed for a weeknight, and when you go there you will know why.  This is a true Tucson gem!

Great brewery, friendly staff, nice area outside to sit
My favorite IPA around
Priced the same as other breweries in the area, $6-$7 for pint

I hesitated before venturing out for my first Burger Up outing because I think of burger joints as the kinds of places that make me feel bloated and miserable when I leave.  Portion sizes are just right at Burger Up.  The buns are great, their onion rings are awesome.  

I particularly enjoy the pimento cheese burger, and their bloody marys are perfect on a Saturday mid afternoon.  

My only complaint would be the communal tables, but to be fair, the crowd seems to respect boundaries.  Wine by the glass prices are a bit steep, too.  Stick to beer.

Good golly Miss Molly this was some good eats!  Luke always pleases. Service is personalized and sets a bar well above the standard. The fresh seafood bar is da bomb!!  The meal was well prepared and a true delight, served with flourish and fan fare. "The Ladies' Man" awards you five stars!
A fantastic spot with amazing Sno-balls. So many great flavors, including many that are all natural. As an added bonus, the service is super friendly.  Can't wait to go back soon!
Truly a full service shop. They contribute to the community as well as cater to families with children all the way up to the seasoned racers.

This place would be an easy 5-star if it was just rated for beauty of the hotel and grounds. It's absolutely beautiful and relaxing. However, you are pretty much stuck there for meals. The hotel is massive and there just aren't enough facilities for lunch and breakfast. The pool is way too small but they are fixing that soon. It gets old waiting in a one hour line for breakfast and lunch. There are long lines at the convenience stores and just about anywhere you can get food. That being said, we love it and will be back. Great staycation for a weekend.

Tonight we decided to go to Pappy's around 7pm, hoping they still had some bbq left because it was a Wednesday night. I guess we were too hopeful. So instead I used the Yelp app to find another restaurant around because I was not familiar with the other restaurants in the area. I never heard of The Good Pie, but it had some great reviews so we decided to head over there. 

We walked in, and personally  I really liked the feel of the room. Exposed brick walls with the old bicycles along one wall. Wooden tables and the fire burning oven in the open. It wasn't terribly busy, but no one really up at the front. And for being first timers here we didn't know if we were to seat ourselves or wait to be seated (no sign). So we awkwardly stand for a few mins and finally get asked how many and then told to pick a table. UH... why not just put a sign? 

Then we sit ourselves at the table of our choosing....... get our water cups and napkins......... then water............ then finally our menu! The menu wasn't very extensive but I didn't mind. I decided on the good pie. Waited for what seemed to be a reasonable amount of time and finally got our pizzas!

The pizza was a little disappointing....wayy too much olive oil. I cut the pizza in half, lifted it a little bit and slanted it so some of the excess could run off.... it was too much of a good thing. Nothing like the picture on yelp. The ingredients tasted fresh and delicious. I just wish they would've spread them out  a little bit better. 1/4 of my pizza had everything, 1/2 had just basil leaves and sauce, 1/4 had cheese and sauce. And I moved the cherry tomatoes around so it'd be a little more evenly spread out on my pizza. 

I bite in, but all I could taste was the burnt crust. That was disappointing. So I peak on the bottom of my pizza, and it was black :( So i examined the underside of my whole pizza and realize that 1/2 of it is super burnt and the other 1/2 is acceptably burnt. That was seriously the most disappointing fact.

Overall, service was okay, food was okay, ambience of the place was great. But what actually counts and makes a restaurant great was just mediocre. Not really interested in going back there....

The food is solid messy BBQ-y hand-you-cups-to-test-all-our-sauces all American belly fill. Little expensive, trendy, not my usual favorite but they do a good job of it and you get exactly what you want out of "let me have that savory chomp of meat." Their fries are awesome. Their BBQ sauces are a little mustardy all-around, but they mesh well with different menu items and equalize. I love that there are vegetarian options but I doubt they attract many with it when the next door panini bar sounds like better fare for veggie fans. 

Hickory Kitchen lacks in space. They got slammed with throngs of screaming young families moments after we calmly sat down in a cozy sunny corner with our order placed. This meant our meal was - by us - rushed to make space. I don't know if it was standard for a Saturday, but they earn some big props for calling down the owner who ran in to bus tables and take over the register for his employees. 

Overall: possibly beware screaming young family crowd for lunch, be assured they call for reinforcements rather than let you suffer, and solid yumminess to expect - get the fries - and feel slightly food comatose the remainder of the day.

Came in on a Saturday and was seen as soon as I completed the paperwork. The staff here is very friendly, approachable and professional. It made all the difference with my experience. Would trek over here again.

If you find yourself having to leave New Orleans and you're flying out... Treat yourself to one last taste and stop at Dots (convenient to the airport)! You'll catch them open round the clock so if you miss them its your fault. My suggestion is you have breakfast... You can't go wrong with the Big Dot!

Wow, where to begin? I was looking for a new barber ever since my old one of 10 years retired. I wasn't sure where I should go, but found the Moose and decided to give it a try. I was far from disappointed. First question after asking my name was, "would you like a drink?". I was more than happy to wait patiently with a glass of makers. Toni was my barber, and I couldn't give enough credit to him. He takes his work seriously and really cares that you look and feel great. Finally, I have never had a haircut where I walked out of the shop feeling as good as I did walking out of The Moose. It's not cheap, but for what you're getting, it's worth every penny.

This location apparently hired Tucson's very own Cesar Millan, a trainer named Jeremy. He alone is worth the five stars: He's helped me over the past year to train my rescue and he went way beyond the $100 I paid for six weeks of dog training classes. When I am stumped, and little Sophie stumps me often, Jeremy always finds a solution. Beyond that, I appreciate the staff, the prices aren't bad, just a solid business.

We've been going to Two Elk since before the environmentalists burned down the first one. The food is what you expect from a mid mountain cafeteria, but the charm, view, and convenience makes up for it. While finding a table is always an interesting process, we always seem to meet a few interesting people.

I've eaten here a couple of times now.  I like the pizza--it's not the best pizza I've had but the best I've found in Santa Barbara so far.  The closest resemblance to thing crust New York Style pizza that I've tried here. Toppings are good, and the biggest plus for me is that it isn't as LOADED with salt as other pies I've had here.  I like to taste other flavors in my food, even my pizza, thanks!  All in all a good place to go out for pizza.

As for ambiance I'm generally not a fan of TVs in restaurants unless its a sports bar, I find them distracting--so if it's date night I'd go somewhere else.

No complaints so far about wait staff or service.
Great views! Nice pool area and clean well maintained! Good seating around bar. Only negative is that Beer is too expensive.

I like this place a lot! Far better than some of the other Mexican places in Springfield. I love the tamales, I've had a few flavors and they don't disappoint, but my favorite is pork with green sauce. My husband had nachos with some kind of beef. THAT was delicious. They also have Mexican Coke in bottles, which is a favorite treat of mine. The flan was good. Not the best I've had, but still satisfying. I wish they had horchata! The atmosphere is nice, very casual. I would go for lunch not a romantic date. The menu is pretty large and I'm excited to keep trying new things.

The old staff is back and the food is as delicious as ever!  I stopped in for "lunch" before an afternoon hearing, and ended up with some ribs, slaw, mashed sweet potatoes, cornbread, and fries.  I thought it was going to be too much, but everything complemented each other perfectly!  The rib meat fell off the bone, the fries were delicious smothered in their Chipotle BBQ sauce, the sweet potatoes were just sweet enough without being sugary, and the corn bread was soft and delicious!

There is a passion in the kitchen here that you can taste in the food!

I cannot pass up browsing a small, independent hardware store because you never know what you are going to find. Perhaps it is that one needed item to finish a project that was waylaid months ago. Perhaps it is something that you didn't know you needed. Either way, you often leave thinking, "my life is going to be better now."

My boyfriend and I were passing this store on our way to Honey's for breakfast when it occurred to me that he needed a wrench to fix his leaking cold water supply pipe.

In nothing flat we were pointed to the tools section and a perfect Stanley wrench. I pride myself on organization, but even I was amazed at the selection that was organized in clean, clear, and almost modular fashion. The salespeople obviously take pride in their workshop like store and are genial enough to point you in the right direction should you be lost. 

In a short time, I was highly impressed. I almost want to invent some project just to go back and feel that my life is about to be more complete.
Amazing place for wings in Tucson. Go here about twice a month to get wings with my staff. Great little hole in the wall Wing Place.

Others have said what I experienced that morning with some friends so I'll keep this brief. We actually ran a half mile to the park on the other side of the freeway to use toilets there before the race. When we returned, the line for the port-potties had moved about 20 feet. 6 to 8 toilets at the start of a race is way short of what's was needed. As a previous post mentioned, because it was not made clear, when the whistle blew, ALL runners looked at the R.D. He blew it again and then yelled, "Go! Run!". Seems like the R.D. may be a nice guy, but in way over his head. Still no results or photos and the race was on the 20th of July. We are disappointed because it could really be a very nice race.

Went to tacos 46 and then decided to check out this place. Definitely a hidden gem.  Best parking is in the Home Depot lot and then enter through the first white door on the south side of the building.  As everyone says it's tiny but the kitchen is rocking with fun and food. Would recommend calling in your order as there is very little waiting room.  
  This is the first Mexican Taqueria I have found in this city that's worth traveling for
Torta bread was fresh and the carne asada has more flavor than any other place.  New favorite by far.

The food was cold and the drinks tasted weird. I believe it is overpriced it's all you can eat buffet but I just got one plate and still had to pay the full price but it's whatever. Definitely not coming back.

I went with the chicken,  cilantro rice, and salad due to previous reviews and was not disappointed!  It was absolutely delicious!  I liked the green sauce best (it was spicier).  The rice was amazing,  too!  My friends got yuca and chicken salad as well as coffee and ice cream truffles.  One of my friends said it was the best coffee she'd ever had!  We were all really happy with our food.   The place was packed,  too, and we all got fast service.

I was starving and stopped off at moe's for some lunch. First time visitor to this chain. I had a chicken burrito bowl with black beans peppers cooked onions pico de gallo lettuce and cheese. Tasty. Liked the idea they included salsa and chips with any order. 

What's really cool is their coke freestyle machine. It makes 106 flavors. Nice concept.

The place is casual and fast. The ingredients tasted fresh and the price was reasonable.

Awesome tacos! I got the shrimp and mahi mahi tacos (grilled) and they were great. I also split the guac with my boyfriend. AS a girl I suggest getting 2 and something small or 3 will fill you. Everything was fresh and the staff were awesome! The only thing is that the guac is a little over priced for what it is and I could have used a little more shrimp in my taco. I will be returning!
We stopped by to meet friends for lunch and was blown away by the food and service. We can't wait to add this to our list of weekly visits!
The is the biggest SCAM!!!! Do not order from this company! I paid $134.00 for merchandise I NEVER received. There is NO one that answers the phone and you cannot leave a message.

A great local diner for those on the go. They take regular breakfast items and add a small bit of local flavor to it. While it won't be a memorable dining experience when I look back on my trip, it definitely got the job done.

Even though we had 10 in our group, it was WORTH the wait!!! Amanda (server) was so efficient & food came out exactly as ordered, AND Jim (owner) came to our table several times-helped serve, made sure everything was fine, and he shared their cool business story, which is why they're SO  successful... a MUST VISIT in Nashville. Best Quality, hands down!

As average as any subpar bbq place. Nothing worth mention. Honestly. Everything drenched in sauce (which means your covering up something).  Fried chicken was decent-but how do you screw that up. Not a surprise this place always looks empty. Its the equivalent to a Hardees that serves bbq. What a wasted location.

The fried sweet plantains are caramelized to absolute perfection. The quarter dark meat chicken was a bit small, but it left room for the enormous portions of plantains and cilantro rice. Amazing quality food!

I actually received pretty good service when I came here one evening. To me, the real problem with Sears is the hardware section isn't as big or as complete as it used to be. Most of Sears has now been taken over by the softer side of Sears and thus, it's no longer of much use to me since I can get clothes at lower prices pretty much anywhere else.

Like walking into a cave with Bacchus himself trying to sell you a bottle or 10. Best selection in town and by far the most enthusiasm for wine, which, in New Orleans, is saying something. Make the trip out.

Came here with my partner after a day of traveling. We had a Groupon deal for this place and it definitely exceeded my expectations (Groupon Now can be a bit of a crapshoot). It seemed like it could get pretty busy, but we were lucky to be seated outdoors right away. Tria has well-arranged sidewalk seating. Our server was attentive without being up my ass (which I hate). The wine and beer list are excellent and very reasonably priced. We had some bruschetta, a brie cheese, and a flourless chocolate cake, all of which were yummy (although the bruschetta is a bit overpriced for what you get). I will definitely be back here when I'm in town next. I know that if I lived in the nabe, it would be a staple.

Breakfast/ Brunch is our absolute favorite meal to eat out, so we were pretty excited to see the new pancake house open up across from the cherry hill mall. Upon arrival the restaurant was pretty empty.. we had the option to dine in or take out; so we picked a booth near the window. The waitress was very kind and walked us through the menu. 

We ordered Oreo pancakes, side of bacon and a Mediterranean omelet. The pancakes was fair, not special and the bacon was slightly over cooked. The real highlight of our meal was the omelet and crispy breakfast potatoes with peppers and onions! The omelet was thick and fluffy- highly recommend. We will definitely come back to try different omelets.

We just moved South from Pittsburgh. What we really miss are the ethnic food stores in Pittsburgh's Strip District; i.e., Italian, Greek, Polish, Spanish, Middle Eastern, spices, sausage store, fishmonger, etc. So when the cable guy gave us a list of craft beer bars, restaurants and the market he and his wife love (Mazzaro's) we decided to check them out. 

Yesterday was the Mazzaro excursion. What a pleasant surprise and fun adventure. We found all that we were looking for at the market plus more. The staff was friendly though very busy. A lot of the customer's weren't  sure what some of the products were and others were helping them and providing suggestions on what they like and how to use. (Of course there will always be those with carts banging into you and pushing others out of the way to get their ticket first. LOL, and yes, I was the recipient of the two overzealous customers.).

Next time we go we will have lunch on the patio. All of the tables were taken so we decided to go home and feast on the bounty we purchased. 

The next visit will also include me having the spumoni, which looked absolutely delicious, and a seat at the coffee bar. Can't wait till then.

Ludwig's never disappoints! My husband hosted his work staff at our home last night and I ordered trays. The presentation of the cheese tray was beautiful, and the hot food was elegant and delicious. Made a wonderful impression, and I highly recommend!
This is the worst restaurant in tampa waiters are rude they don't answer you properly they pretend that we are buzy but they are not never suggest to anyone
I will start on Monday!! Ya right way to good!! A definite try. It's just good for the soul.

First time here and it was great ! Our server was a little quiet but he was still very attentive and respectful. The food here was really good ! Totally fell in love with the salmon fish and chips !!! I've never had such a thing before and I will definitely be craving this when I head back to California. The atmosphere was chill as well. Bathrooms were pretty clean and the room was nice. I like this place.

This will likely become a 5-star review when I have a taste of my 2nd, 3rd or ... well, we can stop counting after that, right?

I tried their Stout (Mastadon Stout brewed for the ISM/Yelp Paleo Party) and loved it. It wasn't as 'cofee' as I expected. Instead, it brought a lot to the party (no pun intended). I could tell they put a lot of thought and heart into the brew. 

I think we have a winner. Bring on the next pint!

I've never had better service at any medical establishment. Before I was ever even a patient their front office staff offered to call my insurance to investigate pricing. Once I went they were very professional and gave me honest answers. My surgery went as smooth as I could have imagined, no swelling or bruising. I did end up with some dry socket and when I called the office they made a time for me to come that morning and there was no charge. Dr. Loyola is very knowledgeable but makes you feel welcome and I completely trusted him doing my surgery. On top of all this, I received a call today that they had a refund check for me, five months after my surgery. That's not something that happens very often in healthcare! Highly recommend!

I came here earlier this year before I discovered YELP, I just had forgot the name of the restaurant. I just had to warn you all not to come here. The restaurant is small, the decor abysmal, the food burnt, flavorless and nasty. Oh yeah, it was in the summer and no AC, it was hot and humid inside. I am so ashamed I even came here. Will never be back again and will never in a million years recommend this restaurant to anyone..... Zero stars

okay, whoever gives this place one star is buzz-kill!

the line does suck, of course, but it's not their fault that the chicken is so darned tasty.  and the staff is always super nice, gracious and apologetic about the wait.  no snobbiness here.  

had the crispy harissa chicken which was amaze-balls, and the garlic chile which i personally wasn't a fan of (too spicy) but my friend loved.

donuts are great too - love the pomegranate nutella tahina donut.  the sugar spice donuts are fantastic too, but truth be told i couldn't exactly tell the difference between the three different flavors.  whatever.  i ate them all anyway.

Food was great, service was not. I'll give them the benefit of the doubt it was an anomaly but it wasn't  busy and no one was very friendly and my order was wrong. Having said that, the coffee was great and the hash was really good--fresh, tasty, and nice portion.
It was ok.... Some locals told us this was the place to go... We were kind of disappointed. Then the waitress charged my friends card twice.

Definitely the worst meal we've had down here in the ten plus years we've been vacationing here. My husband and I both ordered the blackened grouper  when the meals were delivered I thought my husband's jaw was going to hit the table. Without one bit of exaggeration, the portion of grouper was the size of a fish stick! It came with a couple of pieces of sautéed zucchini and squash and our choice of vegetable (French fries).  In addition to being smaller than an appetizer portion, the fish didn't even taste fresh! It was fishy. Plus the restaurant needs a facelift. It's dirty and dated. And the food is way over priced. Save your money. Go across the driveway and have some pizza!
Awesome! Great food, great service! Our waitress Rebecca was wonderful! The Moco Loco was amazing!

It's my second time drinking at this location. Always a great place to be if you prefer to enjoy a nice dark ambience. Servers and bartenders know their concoction(S), it's not overly crowded like most places. I highly recommend this bar :).

On a better day I think Han Dynasty probably is worthy of a 5 star review, but I think we went on an off day. All of our dishes were extremely salty or over seasoned. Not so overpowering that we couldn't eat it, but just enough that each small bite had to be chased down by a huge mouthful of rice. 

Service was good. It was busy but we were seated immediately. The only gap was about 15 minutes between appetizers and main courses. 

The Dan Dan noodles was not the sesame paste type that I am used to, but a more beefy noodle and spicy type. It had great flavor.

Both the dry fry pork and the water spinach were tasty but too salty. When were took our leftovers home, by the next day the vegetables had absorbed the rest of the base and was too salty to eat. Had to throw it out.

Great potential. Would give this place another shot.
I like this place.  They leave the doors open so it seems bigger than it is.  Sometimes it's a little difficult on the weekends to get decent service.

I like Deweys's primary because it's close to my house.  The pizza looks great and the crust is good.  My gripe with Dewey's is that the pizzas are just so salty.  We had the pepperoni, socrates revenge, and bronx bomber.  It's like a eatting a brick of salt.  I'm not sure if it's the amount of salt sauce combined with the salty meat, but the combo so overwhelming, I tastebuds are numb to any other flavor.  Otherwise, if they fix that, I would love it.  

As for the salads, they're a good size, but seems like something you can toss together yourself.  I usually not get because don't want to spend the money on it.

Just walked in as we were headed to another area restaurant. Not only was I t
greeted by the hostess immediately, the manager came out from behind the bar and had a 10 minute conversation. They were actually in the process of closing yet they still offered me the menu! I didn't want to be the jerk who walks in at closing & makes everyone stay an hour later so I said I'd be back. They gave me the menu to home! The hostess & manager gave wonderful descriptions of their specialties & practically begged is to come back. Oh I'll be back!! Don't you worry about that. How can I possibly say no to people who are so kind & enthusiastic about what they do? Looking forward to a good meal!

Super-convenient location, but be ready for incredibly loud music until about 4 am if you stay on Bourbon Street. Obviously, this isn't the hotel's fault.....but the extremely narrow balcony on Bourbon Street is. Great spot, excellent coffee shop, and no complaints about service or quality......just need to widen and connect all balconies.

As a bedrock of the Safety Harbor community it is terrible that this Cosby is tearing down more than 20 legacy "live oaks" in order to pave in a parking lot. Those trees are a vital part of the personality of Safety Harbor and since Choice Hotels purchased them they have proved they do not understand how important community support is for t

This place was awesome! I was really craving ramen and I came across this place on yelp. We got there kinda late...(9:20pm when they closed at 10pm) despite us showing up late, the servers were very nice and patient with us. I liked that they played pop music from different cultures and the dim lighting. The food was delicious. They even had something that my picky fiancé enjoyed. It was only $38 for an appetizer and two meals. (We left with leftovers.) If we ever come back to Nashville, we will be going back.

It's a wonderful place. My friend who lives in NOLA brought me here to hang out as the locals do. The food is not traditional "touristy" NOLA food, but it's simple, clean, light, local, and absolutely delicious. I love that there's live music, but it's a bit hard to find a place to hear it depending on what time you come. Come here for the food, come here for the wine, come here for the music - it is ALL good.

Went on a friend's birthday for a birthday dinner and had a very bad experience. A very long wait despite having reservations, and then it took forever just to get a drink from the bar. The food was very, very disappointing--I ordered the lettuce wraps and left hungry. We split a few appetizers, including the crudite/hummus plate--I was just shocked at how overpriced it all was. This is definitely for the yuppie set that doesn't mind spending $ on mediocre food.

I wish I read these reviews before we hired Mayflower because we had a very awful experience with the company.  I do not normally write reviews that hurt companies but this experience warrants one.

My mother and father moved from St. Louis up to Chicago and my parents are older and therefore needed the help of movers.  I could not help them move because I was in middle of moving myself.  I wish I had moved at a different time because my parents could not have been in worse hands.

The caliber of employees/movers they sent to help my mom were horrible.  I will just list some key moments during the move.


-Telling my mother "Don't you have a husband" whenever she asked them to move something to another spot.... It was agreed upon and paid for that they would do this extra work.  My parents are older!  They are not able to move these things anymore.

-Lewd subject matters for conversation were audibly projected through the neighborhood and in front my parents.

-Argumentative when asked to move certain things to the basement.  Again, this was agreed upon to be done when Mayflower was hired.

-After getting upset about moving things to the basement, the movers proceeded to intentionally drop and slam items around the house.  Many items are now permanently damaged.


We called and complained about the movers behavior and the customer service representative told us that the mover who argued and slammed items would not be paid.  This does not really fix any problems.


I will make sure to tell people to hire anyone but Mayflower.  Thanks for making a emotional and difficult time just even more awful.

I ate here with my partner and our nephew for under 40.00 bucks......that never happens.  All three of us left full and satisfied.  We all enjoyed everything we ordered and would have given the place five starts if not for the run down area inside.  It won't take much to fix the roof and throw a coat of paint. This is south tampa after all.
Hannah is wonderful! I have come to her several times for waxing and tinting.  She always remember me and we have great conversations while she works her magic! I highly recommend her.

This review is from February 2017

I heard about this location during my tour guide while i was in NOLA last month, however when i went into it not what i was expecting. This is located in the French Quarter and a lot of tours take place around there I didnt do a reading however i did look around. There was a lot of people walking around and looking at stuff which made it hard to take your time and browse. Someone was having a reading done because the curtains were pulled and they had a sign up about it. This was a fun experience, not much help from the lady that was there she just stayed behind the desk watching.

I have been here 3 times and had Mike as my waiter all of those times. I love the lamb burger. And the service is impeccable. Previously had the steak tar-tare. I am usually too full for dessert. I wish this place wasn't closed on Sunday. But I can highly recommend it.
Excellent! Original Chicago dog on the grill. Every bit worth the calories. Choice of fresh buns. I chose to have my poppyseed bun grilled. Quaint atmosphere and friendly staff.

This was a great lunch outing before Christmas. It was decorated beautifully and put you in the holiday spirit. My sister and aunts had a wonderful time! The pink petal drink was delicious as well as our lunch, which was the chicken salad sandwich and soup or arugula salad! Wonderful! We topped it off with a caramel latte with hazelnut and coconut cream cake! Heavenly!! The Cake slices are so big four people can eat it!

You must go!

Un.Be.Lievably delicious.

Hubs and I stopped in St. Charles to crash with a friend on our cross-country road trip back from our honeymoon, and the goal was to get BBQ in every city where we dined.

This was by far the best experience we had. We sidled up to the bar and loved seeing the old rusty butcher's-knife tap handles.

The bartender was friendly, greeted and talked with us for a while, recommended a couple of local beers (all the ones on tap are local craft!), and we ordered some specials to go. We drank the beers while we waited, and they were delicious. The wait, by the way, was almost nonexistent. They had our food out to us in I think less than 7 minutes.

I got the Texas-style brisket on special, with a side of sweet potato casserole and--I honestly can't remember the other side, because that one was so bomb, as were the ones with DH's meal.

DH got the pick-two, with sausage and pulled pork, sides of cheesy grits and bacon-braised greens.

Holy. Moly. It was all so mouthwatering that I wanted to inhale it. Portions were huge, too, so we had plenty left over for breakfast omelets in the morning. Thrilled that we made this awesome decision in our brief 12-hour visit to St. Charles. Can hardly wait to visit this place again.

My husband and I ate here and the food was pretty good! Our waiter was very friendly, yet not too annoying. We tried shrimp for the first time, and yet we still weren't fans of the texture, the sauce it came with was delicious. The dinner rolls were excellent, as well as the salads that came with our entrees. The steaks were delicious, maybe a tad salty but good anyway! The restaurant itself was small, but we had no problem getting a seat right away!

We are avid sushi lovers and I love fruit on top of sushi. It may sound weird but trust me, it's delicious! This place has a huge variety of rolls at reasonable prices. It's in a great location and can get pretty crowded on a weekend night.

we go here about 4-5 times a month~!
my family's new favorite restaurant~
considering that it's a chinese style buffet, i'm very impressed with the sushi, maki, and sashimi selection, and on top of that the price for dinner is only $11.99!!

I have to say, they have recently gotten rid of some of my favorite hot food dishes, such as fried oysters, and baked scallops, which were amazing!! and also their hibachi is not as good as it used to be, but all in all, for what you are paying, i honestly cannot find a better deal!

they seem to be trying to cut costs here and there, but I hope they don't cut too much, because I love coming here..

also surprisingly, compared to all other Chinese buffets, the staff here speak pretty good English, which is hard to find at other restaurants, which is a huge plus!

Overall, it is very clean, and well kept, and I hope they bring back my baked scallops!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
Best Italian food in the area for sure!  I've been there twice so far and everything was delicious.  It's so close too, I'm sure I'll be going there often.

Great value dinner!  Food was good, great price, cheap draft beer, but the wait was a bit much.  Place was full at 5 and people didn't get food until past 6!  We got the grouper tacos, ribs, slaw, beans, cheese bread, and key lime pie.  All the food was excellent!  I would definitely recommend this place... maybe go at like 7 to avoid the first rush.
This is a really great hotel.  First class service and most of all the best location on Bourbon street.  Parking is very expensive, be forewarned.

I'm slightly conflicted about this because I came here strictly for the chicken Marsala as it's one of my favorite dishes.  My date's dish, the lobster ravioli had delicious scallops, pretty good shrimp, and I really didn't care for the lobster ravioli.  The lobster seemed slightly rubbery and not all that flavorful.

Onto the Marsala, unless there is something I'm not very aware of as far as the potential differences between a Naples Marsala and a northern Marsala, I'm gonna go ahead and come out and say that this isn't Marsala - and this is coming from someone that generally likes a tradish Marsala, then add some heavy whipping cream to the sauce.  This one is just too creamy.  I could barely detect that the chicken itself was cooked in a little bit of Marsala wine, but the creamy mushroomy sauce just completely dominated.  

I still gave it 4 stars, though, because I love places like this, and really, all of the food was cooked very well - nothing burned, dry, etc., but unless they change the Marsala sauce, I won't be back.  Also, the service was very good, and the owner hugged almost every person that walked through the door.  I'm assuming all of the 5 star reviewers really like hugs.

Blunders every time. My husband has been using this compounding pharmacy, under the recommadation of his post cancer doctor, for an injectable compound.  Each time we drove the 70 miles to this pharmacy, there was an issue.  Come to find out, the pharmacy has a"relationship" with the the doctor, as long as the patient remains under his care.  If the patient chooses to go with another doctor, the pharmacy changes the cost and extras given with the rx.  This last visit was our last, having been misinformed by a staff member over the phone, then no call back when told they would look into the script, we have again faced another blunder with Westchase Compounding Pharmacy.  Today, there are far too many choices in compounding pharmacies to use one that makes this type of errors over and over.

Drinks 5 small amount but delish 
App 5 empanadas r amazing 
Entree 4 too saucy 
Service 3 short and unfriendly

Ok, I have to start out by saying I NEVER thought I'd be writing a 5 star review for Chuck E. Cheese.  However, I had my son's 5th birthday party there this weekend and we couldn't have been happier. 

We have been avid Peter Piper-goers for years and have had several bday parties there. My son saw a commercial for Chuck E. Cheese a couple months ago and became obsessed with the idea of having his party there. After trying everything I could think of to talk him out of it, I gave in. 

I scheduled the party online, which was a cinch. We also got an extra 20 tokens for scheduling online and an extra 100 for having the party on a Sunday. 

Our host was Xavier and he was GREAT! Always available, checking in on us and totally on top of everything. They make a big show for the kids celebrating their birthdays: an awesome blow-up crown, air guitar with Chuck E., ticket blaster machine. My boy definitely felt the love. 

Now, it's not cheap and the food is what you'd expect. We paid about $250 for a party of 15 kids and 10 adults. And we brought our own cake and party favors. But, in my experience, that's equivalent to how much you'll pay for most other kids' party places. Plus, their games take a lot less tokens than PPP and they have the huge tube that runs across the play room and that's FREE!  And the kids just love that thing! I found that the kids played so much longer without coming back to ask for more tokens than they do at PPP. 

Finally, I'd be remiss if I didn't mention the awesome security. It's so comforting knowing there's no way a kiddo is getting out the door wihout his or her parent.

They really do a great job at our Chuck E. Cheese and we will definitely be back!!

They Have authentic Chinese and sea food, and karaoke rooms upstairs.
This meal consisted of Two lobsters for $19.95. 
Walnut shrimp, and salt baked scallops and squid.

We stopped in for an early dinner before a show and had an absolutely amazing experience.  The restaurant interior and decor is very modern and upscale.  Our waiter was very knowledgeable about the menu, sources for ingredients, wine list, etc and made a few recommendations.  We had the grit souffle and crawfish salad to start and both were fantastic.  We decided to try something new and went for the cobia and antelope as our entrees.  The cobia was on top of dirty rice with crawfish tails and was cooked to perfection.  The antelope was served with kale and mash potatoes with a strawberry maceration.  Everything was fantastic but I'm not sure strawberries were the right complement.  For dessert we shared the strawberry shortcake.

This is a fabulous restaurant preparing innovative cuisine with a touch of southern flair.  We will definitely be back!

I did notice the wines by the glass were primarily Californian wines and were very much overpriced.  For example the Ridge is a $40 retail bottle but they're pouring $16 glasses.  The specialty cocktails are also a bit expensive, at about $15.  They've got a pretty good beer selection.

They changed chefs and the food is allot better... I got asked to return after a coworker suggested we go. Had the meat lovers sandwich, friends had chicken, pulled pork and brisket. We were all happy!

After a long drive home we were looking for a nice quiet dinner so decided to try this place. I called to reserve a tbl and was told not to worry about it because after 8:30 all guests would have been seated. To be sure, I asked the young lady if she'd like my name to hold a table but was assured we were fine and to just come in. Kitchen is open to 10pm. My date and I arrived at 9:42 and asked to be seated. There were three tables at the time and we were starving. The server reluctantly said hello, I asked for a table and she made a face followed by the infamous "let me check with chef on that". Needless to say, chef said no and we were turned away! I've been in the hospitality business for the better part of 20 years and this is my #1 pet peeve. It's a luxury to have guests coming in the door and the last thing you do is turn them away, especially like this. The girl even had the nerve to tell me I didn't have a reservation! I'll stop my rant here. Needless to say, I'll never go back and I'll make sure I tell all my coworkers/friends to stay away. 
It's a shame because I'm sure the place is great (3 bells) but they have a loser chef with a poor attitude and that's just bush league. Nice work cheffrey.

My fiance and I ate here recently, and I have to say I was pleasantly surprised. I had heard often enough that it was excellent, but I usually take others' high praise with a grain of salt. However, the Smiling Elephant definitely lived up to the hype. Both of our entrees were incredibly delicious - the best Thai food we've had in Nashville, by far. However, our appetizer (the spring rolls) were NOT very good, hence the four stars instead of five. Overall, though, I'd say a great place to go!
Excellent food.  Reasonable prices.  Attentive waitresses.  Good nachos and salsa.  Plenty of parking.

First time here so I was surprised when I was told "We're here". This is it. Wow! Interesting because I would have kept on driving. Truth: I don't think there was a sign visible on the outside.  I love it! Lots of tasty choices. I was eager to try the Sonoran hotdog. My first. Maybe I'm use to a simple grilled dog. It was ok. I didn't taste the bacon. And I love my bacon! Definitely upgrade to the beer battered fries. My nephew had them with his burger.  We could not keep our hands out of his basket. I should have stayed with my standard: burger. They had a delicious selections. No desserts btw. I'm not a beer drinker but I do enjoy a good craft beer. I especially love trading the seasonal ones.  Our nameless server took our drink order but didn't mention the new ones on the board.  I gave her a list for my flight including the beer she liked. When I'm stuck on a decision,  I ask our server what they typically order whether it be app, entree, dessert, or drink. Usually they enthusiastically tell what they love on the menu. Miss Nameless shrugged & pointed to her fav.  I couldn't even remember what it was. I did enjoy the NCAALE & the mocha java porter. The other one was the raspberry. I'm giving Barrio 4 stars due to the service.  The bartender who helped me with the shuffleboard pucks was a helpful cutie tho. All in all I would come back again due to the atmosphere & menu.

Best seafood place ever!  Honestly, I have never had better, fresher, juicer Lobster ever in my life.  I don't mind the long wait and the uncomfortable bar stools.  The food is more than enough to make up for it.  We generally order the largest lobster they have for the day to go with their deliciously prepared clam chowder.  It's a must-stop whenever I'm around the area.

I thought the Hyatt was supposed to be pretty nice. At least for the price, it should've been. My bathroom had pubic hair on the floor and in the tub, so I called the front desk and someone came up and cleaned it again, but all they did was push it around so I had to pick it up with a Kleenex and throw it away. My pillowcase had a few small stains on it. For breakfast, I went to the restaurant on the first floor and they gave me oatmeal that was barely warm. All in all, not a great experience. The 2 stars is for the view and the gym was good.

I would like to thank all the staff for making our stay for the weekend a relaxing and comforting experience for majority of our family members who came all around the globe to wish our aunt farewell to rest in paradise. 

Big shout out to Stephanie for taking good care of us with what ever we needed. She did her absolute best to make sure our room was clean and supplied us with anything we needed as we prepared my aunts funeral.

Thank you so much Stephanie!!

Located on the 3rd block of Bourbon this is a great place to eat. The eggs benedict are really good as are the shrimp and grits. Fresh oysters are just that, huge and great. Grilled oysters are some of the best i'v had. No need to go to acme and stand in line, can't beat this place. We visit nola a lot and always eat here.

Buena Onda has the best tacos in Fairmount. I LOVE the tofu taco, grilled or fried. You can't go wrong with the shrimp or the mahi mahi either. The side of corn is to die for. The only thing that is hit or miss here is the salad. Sometimes it comes out perfect, and sometimes it's just boring and dry. Skip trying to be healthy and just get the good stuff. You won't be disappointed.

This place is a must for dessert everytime I am dining on Grand!

Literally, we start with dinner, walk up for gelato and an Espresso Cubano to set us up for the remainder of the evening, where we will no doubt be sipping naughty martinis at Absolutli Goosed!  

The staff is always very nice and give too much gelato :-)  Very comfortable seating and ambiance!

They have a very broad range of gelato flavors...my faves so far have been the London Fog, Chai, Blueberry and Pistachio.  Really can't go wrong, they do all of the flavors well!

This place is good but not "oh my gah good." I wouldn't wait around for the place. I got the pigs in the blanket. They were okay. My boyfriend got the old fashion pancakes, they tasted better. They do have the most fluffy butter I've ever seen. Hash browns were really good, loved the crisp crust but overpriced. Almost $4 for literally 4 bites.
The service here was friendly and fast. The mini Cuban was delicious!!! I highly recommend trying this out for starters if you've never had Cuban before.

Reading some of the complaints about this place while I was on the train heading to Tucson, got my kind of nervous. I had never been to Tucson and had already made a reservation at the Roadrunner, but was having second thoughts after reading about strange people roaming the premises, meth heads, and a rude staff.

1st, to the complaints about having to stay in an apartment blocks away from the hostel; this happened to us as well, but I fail to see what the problem was. We ended up getting an apartment (less than a block from the hostel) with a full kitchen, bedroom, bathroom, fenced in backyard, and front courtyard. I don't have any problem with that. So what if a lot of people living there were long term residents- aren't most people long term residents of somewhere?

2nd, I did see some crazy looking people lining up in front of the Plasma center early in the morning, but what city of 250,000+ doesn't have sketchy inhabitants? Overall, I felt just as safe as I have in most places I've been around the country.

Finally, the staff. One of the main complaints I read is that they were rude; I met three different staff members and they were all nothing but kind. One was a bit annoying about checking out - knocking on our door at 10:30 (this is why they only got 4 stars) - but was at least kind about it.

The only weird thing that happened was them knocking on our door in the middle of the afternoon and telling us that they needed to take the bunkbed. We weren't using it, but it made me wonder what they would have done had we not answered. Would they have let themselves in?

There is no doubt in my mind that I would (and will) stay there again.

disclosure: review is for food only and not on the whiskey unfortunately

a friend took me here expressing this was the best burger in all of philly. 

service was efficient and there wasn't a wait at all that tuesday evening at 6pm. we were bummed they didn't have a happy hour. the burger portion was super generous and i had trouble eating it without my utensils. the quality of the ingredients was great but i still felt as if something was missing.. wish there was an extra sauce or dressing element to make it a bit juicer though the meat was far from dry. it was just missing something for me. there was a long list of add on's (at a cost) that maybe i should have splurged on? it was pretty dark in there and i was too lazy to tackle that part of the menu. i was uncomfortably full after so i'd probably share a burger if there is ever a next time.

it was a decent burger but not worth any potential long wait and definitely out of my normal price range for a burger. this place left me really missing home/in n'out...

This is one of those times I wish Yelp allowed us 1/2 ratings because I would give this place 3 1/2 stars. I think Zea is all about bang for your buck -- it's not very expensive and you get a ton of decent food. Nothing very creative, but solid food. However, the service needs vast improvement. But I'd return because the prices are extremely reasonable. Atmosphere is decent.
Once again, great food and even better service.  Our waitress Little Tony is the best.  Ask for her by name.  Food is always good.

Best pies I've ever had.  We buy a pie for every major family meal so I've tried nearly they're entire selection. The Dutch apple pie and the sugar pie are my favorites.  Always nice to support a small business that makes a superior product.

I recently got a cheesesteak and bag of chips from this place. Cheesesteak was gross. Literally tasted like bagged boiled cafeteria meat on a roll with ketchup and onions. 

I will never go here again and recommend that all follow suit.

I bought flowers here for my rental property a couple of months ago, and the employees kindly answered all my questions about perennials, watering, and all that mumbo jumbo I know nothing about.  They have a very nice selection and sell some cool gardening accessories as well.  The only down-side is the parking.  They don't have a private lot so people just park on the street, which can get mighty busy and a little dangerous for kiddos during rush hour.

I've been to so many sushi restaurants and I'm really a picky person, none of the other sushi restaurant like this one provides high quality sushi--fewer rice, more meat and vegie,and lower price!! the most importantly, as much as we can eat, i will definitely come back for it as usual!

I'm sure a lot of people's  enjoyment depends on how funny the comedian is that night (comedy clubs are usually a hit or miss). My experience however was very delightful. Funny stand up comics, good cocktails although the food could use some improvement. But it's great to go for some laughs. Our tickets were free in stipulation of a 2 drink minimum for each guest, fine with me! I recommend the blueberry lemon drop!

Apparently this restaurant has caught a lot of flak for poor service. And good for them, they've read the reviews because we had two attentive servers that were constantly making sure we had everything we needed. A water glass was never less than half empty. The escargot and tomato stack were great. Entrees were good but not something I'd go back for. Overall, nice ambience and good experience. They turn over a lot of tables and do it well. If you're looking for a local intimate dining experience then look elsewhere. But if you are staying in the French quarter and need a good spot that won't disappoint but not dazzle, this is it.

Came here with a group of girls, so we were able to order a bunch of different things to try.  I gotta say they made the best squid steak I ever had.  Flavor was amazing.  

The only downside, was that the service was really slow, and everything is extremely over priced.  The food took forever to come out, and we had to wave the waitress down for drinks.

If we had gotten better service, and the prices not so high, I would have given them 4 stars.
Their pizza was ok, I think they need to cook the pizzas alittle more and have more tastier cheese. They do have a large delivery area in southern Tampa, as well as Ybor.

Overall, 4 stars. The food was great but was not welcomed with a warm and inviting feeling. Service was overall good especially since the restaurant is quaint. 

BYOB is always a plus.

Had the late night hungries. This was the only place serving food around us. The beer was cold, the bartenders were drunk. One was in training so yeah, that's what he was teaching her. The hallway to the bathroom is creepy, FYI. After ordering,  a couple of our group members motioned to the floor. The bartender laughed and said, "Which one did you see? Since they are working on the streets, it's stirring them up and they are everywhere." I asked what they were talking about.  RATS!! And on cue our food arrived.  OH, HE'LL NO! Exist stage left. Gross AF.
Jennifer was amazing! She helped us find what we needed and made us feel welcome. What a lovely store, would recommend!
I love this dive bar! It's a perfect place to get together to watch a game and you can even order food to be delivered!

Came here for Sunday brunch, of course the place was crowded but we didn't have to wait long to get seated. The food was delicious and our waitress was nice. However this place can get super cramped when busy and becomes hard to get around for the buffet.

Okay, don't jump on me for this, but its partially my fault because I held them to such high expectations (due to the hype and anticipation of them opening up here) before actually eating at this location. I read so much about it on Facebook and the likes......so reading and seeing the yummy pics; well I just knew it would be all that.....untill yesterday.....

Me and my bf Vince went to BlackFinn for Sunday lunch yesterday. The atmosphere was cool and it was really nice inside. The staff was pleasant as well, so I'm thinking "hum...I like...". We ordered  a couple of mojitos and we also had another drink, which was okay.  Time to order; I ordered the Cuban sandwich, hold the mustard, and add mayo instead....with Black Finn fries and my bf ordered the Prime Rib sandwich with au jus and the same fries.  We got our order, which took a bit of time but it was okay. Everything looked so yummy and I knew they were going to meet my expectations. Now mind ya, my bf put off going to BlackFinn since they day they opened and I've been on him to go here. So anyway, the fries were a bit salty, but good. I had a choice of two dipping sauces, which I believe were ranch and barbeque. Delicious! I bit into the sandwich and what did I taste? A mouth full of mustard!!! Eeewww!! Okay, did I not say "hold the mustard"? So lo and behold, my food had to be returned while my bf ate his food. His beef about his sandwich (no pun intended) was that there was more bread than meat. I looked at it and I noticed the same thing. Also, the au jus was a bit low as well and wasn't enough for the sandwich.  So I'm like the little old lady from the back-in-the-day commercials saying "Where's the beef?" LOL. Wow! 

Finally, after he finishes his sandwich, my food finally comes out and guess what? They left the swiss cheese off the sandwich. WTF! Okay, so at this point I'm like "forget it, just take it back." How many times must I send my sandwich back to get it right? Now I must say that the manager on duty was accommodating and she took care of the check and apolgized for the errors. So for her professionalism and the fact that the staff was very polite, I give them two stars. Will I go back....yes I will give them another chance to redeem themselves, but all in my ear is my bf saying that there must have been a reason why he hesitated to come here and this is why.  Oh well......

Went in this past Sunday night and finally made it down the menu to their tortas. They've been consistently busy for the past 6 months or so, with only a table or two empty each time we've gone in. So, obviously, the word is getting out on this place.
The torta was good but, in all honesty, it was not the best I've ever had. It was also a little small compared to others I've had. The meat was fantastic though, of course. I had the pastor, which I think is the best choice for a torta. I also had a carne asada taco which, as always, was fantastic.
Per the service, I've figured it out, I think. When the waiter comes up and takes your drink orders, he/she will be back and, when they come back, you need to order then. Otherwise, you'll be waiting a little while until they come back again. Yeah, that's not much time, but that's just how it is. You'll also likely be asked at least twice by different people about what you want to drink. Don't take offense, they're just trying to be efficient. Food often comes out super-quick because they have most of the meats made already. I don't blame them on that one though, of course. I mean, have you ever asada-d your own carne? Takes a while.
I've also determined that they are hell-bent on not giving me corn tortillas for my tacos. Third time I've been given flour after asking. Hey, that's okay though.
Another weird thing: on this last visit, I noticed on the ticket that the server's listed name was "Mercado." Eh? Maybe just what they give all tickets.
Another cool thing: you get free refills on aguas frescas, including horchata. Damn, that stuff is sugary though. Get your insulin ready.
Torta + taco + large caramelo (that my companion ordered) = $11.40 w/ tax. Not bad at all. Plus, we were in there less than 30 minutes even though they were busy.
They are now doing a promotion on Thursday nights with $0.99 domestic beer.

I really want to like this place; they have a really cool concept with interesting drinks; however the excitement stops there. But because of the service, and the environment the rude bartenders create, I will never go back. I went recently with a group of girls celebrating a bachelorette party. This was at the beginning of the night, none of us were drunk, we're all a little bit older, so we were very quiet and tame, as far as groups of girls go. 

The bartenders were nothing but rude to all of us. I hate nothing more than an entitled bartender. You're in the service industry... in the quarter... Anyway, the bride to be wanted a picture at each bar she went to, and we asked the bartender in a nearly empty bar if he could either take a picture or be in the picture, and his responses were beyond rude. 

Also, my friend asked for change for a $20, and the bartender completely forgot, and made her sit and wait for 15 minutes while he did other things. My friend just patiently waited. and when the bartender realized he forgot, he wasn't even apologetic. 

Don't waste your money on this place, go to Latitude 29 where the bartenders are nice and accommodating, the drinks are better at Latitude anyway in my opinion.

Great location, great food, and friendly staff! There are only a few seats and the store gets pretty crowded with people waiting for their food. I saw a lot of online order ready to go at the counter and think that would be the smart move the next time I want to come during a weekday lunch rush. Weather permitting, it's great to grab some HCV and eat it in Rittenhouse Square across the street! I've come a few times with friends and coworkers and no one has complained about their choices (vegetarians and meat eaters alike)!

We've been coming here since it opened more than ten years ago.  It has been consistently great over that time.

On our last visit, the ceviche was outstanding, the sangria wonderful and, while the menu items had changed a little since our last visit, were still delish.  As always, there was a little wait for a table.

Great selection of breakfast food to choose from. I got the 1/2 lb country fried steak with gravy and it was really good and very filling. Wife got a build your own combo with healthy food for her and that was exactly what she wanted. We don't have these where we live or we would eat at these restaurants often

I would've given it no stars at all if this were an option. My wife ordered cheesecake and coffee. The cheesecake was ridiculously tiny and the coffee tasted like dirt. I ordered a chicken pesto sandwich which was simply about-to-go-bad chicken on stale bread. The only Ok thing about this restaurant was the veggies; they did look and taste fresh. But that's about it. I do not recommend at all.

We loved this place! Very nice atmosphere, the live piano was a nice touch. The view is amazing, the dining room is practically over the water!!
