Of course I booked late and I didn't want to spend $200+/night on these hotel rooms! Otherwise this place is ginormous. The service (shuttle), lunch/drinks were really well done.  This place is immaculate; I do not know how many workers they staff.  

The food of course is overpriced (I had lunch/dinner at Wasabi. My bento box was $25.  Overpriced right?)  I also had lunch at the pizza place Paisano (forgot the name).   

If you decide to stay at the hotels across the street from the convention center (it is only 1 mile away - across from the McGovick Pwky).  They have Cracker Barrel, Apple Bees, Chillis?, McDonalds there.  The hotel I stayed in (being on a student budget) was crappy but I can't complain for $55/night.  It was Days Inn. It was walkable to shuttle pick up stop at Marriott Hotel (walk ~0.3 miles).  

They have Finleys pub, FUSE (night/club), STAX burger, Jack Daniels and more restaurants inside this convention center.  

I posted some photos.

I can NOT believe there is any less than a 5 star review for this establishment.  For the same price as just an oil change any where else, I can get an oil change, car wash, and inside vacuuming and detailing.  It just makes sense.

Finally open, The Livery makes use of the former IPD Horse Livery and is the newest endeavor by the Cunningham Group- the masterminds who brought Mesh, Bru Burger and Union 50 to the Mass Ave area. 

Livery features an extensive tequila menu in both of their bars. Yeah, I said two bars. One downstairs and another one upstairs that overlooks a patio that's going to be pretty nice this coming spring. 

Menu features small plates..  ceviche, yuca fries and jamon serrano top the appetizers with octopus, choripan and skirt steak make up the more substantial (and higher price point) items. 

For my meal I went with the Livery Margarita ($9) made with maestro dobel diamante, Lazaroi triplo, fresh lime juice and agave. Add some salt to the rim and this was pretty tasty!

I also went with the roaster vegetables with chimichuri. A nice and somewhat healthy way to dine. 

Valet parking is a must around here unless you happen to be lucky enough to score a parking spot out front or on Mass Ave. if walking, the door is on the north side of the building back a bit. 

So happy to be neighbors with this place. My VIP card is going to get a

The best Indian flavor in the St. Louis area has a new location. Lucky me! If you're craving Indian or wanting to try it for the first time then search no more. Try the Lunch buffet or go for dinner. You'll love the flavors from Spice of India! My favorite is the Chicken Tikka Masala!

Delicious food and drinks!! The restaurant is colorfully decorated with sugar skulls on the walls and festive chalkboards with special drinks and tacos written on them. 
The grapefruit margarita was sooo yummy and my husband had a Mexican mule. It was very spicy but delicious. 
We had the appetizer of blt guacamole which was pretty good. Basic guacamole topped with bacon, but very good basic guacamole. 
I had the poblanos enchiladas which were really flavorful, but filling! Come hungry. 
My husband has the carnitas tortas and dirty fries. Those fries will be in my dreams for weeks!! Luckily it was a cheat meal so we didn't care too much about calories, these things have to be loaded in calories and fat haha. They're covered in cheese and bacon and jalapeños. So good. 
Overall we liked this place for a first visit and I'm sure we will be back!

The habit, chain, not a chain? I don't care!  All I do care about is this is a solid, fresh tasting burger.  Not amazing, not the best burger I've ever had, but solid.  Someone complained about all of the references to In-n-Out, but I think the comparison is completely appropriate.  The style of burger is similar and it gives a person an idea of what kind of burger to expect.  It is similar, but in my opinion, a little better.  Maybe because we of the weather, or because there was a teriyaki burger option.  Had a bit of a regular char burger too, and that was solid as well.  But my onion rings were what was really good.  Crisp and you could actually eat it with the onion.  The onion didn't come flying out the first bite like most onion rings.  The berating on them was really good.  I would also like to say how awesome it is that the habit's burgers come with caramelized onions automatically.  All burgers should.

So yes, I can make a much better burger at home, but the habit makes a soli fresh tasting burger.

I really like this place. Reasonable prices for the large portions. I love BBQ sauce, I put it on everything, so I really like places like this that have BBQ sauce readily available in many different flavors. I've had 2 sandwiches, both were delicious. I've tried a bunch of different sides too; all were good.

It has never been busy. Been there for lunch and dinner, and both times it's awkwardly empty; maybe 15 tables at dinner, and 3 at lunch. Not complaining though, because that just means more attention from the waitress. I just hope it stays in business.

Finally made it down for brunch today, and loved everything.  Great service, great mimosas.  Food was amazing.  We ordered the loaded biscuits and gravy, sweet potato hash, and 'chicken' & waffles.   So delicious.  Would LOVE to see a kids' menu at brunch.  The regular portion is a bit too much food, and a little pricy, for our 6yr old. But it tasted good, so we helped eat his meal. :) 

Will absolutely be back. Try the noochy grits and the braised kale!  Yum!

To begin, the atmosphere of this place is awesome! They have a ton of outdoor seating available and the lay out breaks the large restaurant into smaller sections to create a more intimate dining experience. I ordered the Summer Fizz cocktail while we waited 20 minutes for our table and it was very tasty but small for $10. We ordered the brussel sprouts as an appetizer and they were delicious! I love when brussel sprouts are slightly charred. I ordered the cheese empanadas and they were good but I wish I would've chosen one with meat. My boyfriend ordered the skirt steak and loved it. We will definitely be back to Livery!

Came here twice on a short trip. Food and ambience are both great. The most amazing thing about this restaurant is our waiter Gary. Was fortunate enough to enjoy his company both times and he couldn't have been more hospitable. Come and ask for Gary!
SLOW EST BARTENDER EVER. Took 15 plus minutes each time, all night, at half capacity bar. Horrible

Very Hipstery and quaint! Kinda reminds me of a prohibition era speak-easy with all of the wood and lighting! I love that you can see everything going and being made if your sitting at the bar! I got the sopapilla donut and iced coffee, but their menu changes every day I heard! Absolutely amazing! The donut was light and fluffy, I probably could have eaten a dozen! The iced coffee was smooth and delicious, but I'm a coffee addict so any douse of caffeine is sensational! Definitely a dive and worth sitting, enjoying the atmosphere, and a lovely donut or several!!

Horrible customer service!!!  Called to check on something and was put on hold forever then was disconnected.  Called back twice and couldn't get anyone to even answer the phone in any department.  Seems like no one wants to work there and they ignore the phone hoping you will finally give up... very unprofessional!

I like this Sam's Club because it is in an excellent location and has great prices ranging from Gas, Liquor, Food, and Electronics, Tires etc etc. Their warranties are also great and are not difficult to take advantage of when you need it. I love that I can go in there and spend less than 20 dollars and have a dish for a party that will serve well over 10 people. I also like that I can drive 2-3 extra blocks and find gas significantly cheaper. For example today the gas was approx 3.70-3.79 on 86th street. I drove a few miles down the road and got gas for 3.51 there. That is extremely well worth it when you are in a budget and drive an SUV. The gas alone is worth the membership. The only reason I gave them a 4 star rating and not a 5 is because for all the hard work they do they could pay their employees a bit more. Additionally their lines tend to get a bit long at times which can be nerve-wracking especially when there are employees who want/need extra hours. Other than that kudos from me.

This is becoming our new late night delicious spot. I am giving the food 5 stars and the overall 4 stars. It can be so loud that it's hard to have a conversation. Also not a great spot for Fri/Sat unless you like to be wedged up on top of others and you also happen to have ear plugs on your person. Servers are really friendly and service is quick. Love the hidden patio for a late night in the cool breeze and a good beer. A variety of local and import beers (and a cider) on draft and a drink special every day. 

I'm usually ordering from the late night menu, which includes the apps and pizzas. The spinach and artichoke dip with pita chips is the best I have ever had. Super creamy and full of cheesy goodness. Oh and there are some veggies in it, probably spinach and artichokes, whatever. The wings are phenomenal! Super meaty and the sauce is perfection. The garlic cheese fries aka crack fries are addictive! Olive tapenade = yummy in my tummy, My hands down fav pizza is the Robert Browning. Meats, banana peppers, cheese, covered in spring mix and italian dressing. When you feel compelled to eat a salad, but you really want pizza. I have 2 words Flippin Delicious!

Good Stay & just as expected for a Quality Inn. Was hesitant due to previous reviews. Hotel lobby was clean as well as room. Room was on first floor, and recently remodeled.  Flat screen tv in room, and standard cable tv w/ HBO, etc.
Parking lot clean & easily accessible. 

Normal hotel free continental breakfast, free wifi (that actually worked w/decent speed).  Nearby fast food within walking distance. 

Clerk, Jason, was very helpful upon arrival.  Would stay again.

This place is really fun. The pricing isn't too high if you're looking for an affordable dining experience in Santa Barbara. All of the staff are extremely friendly and the service is great. Sushi is always good. The hibachi is also a safe bet. Definitely recommend.

I feel like if Sheldon Cooper created a winter wonderland, this is just a small taste of what it would look like. 


Jingle Rails is a yearly holiday tradition where they create different landmarks from Indy to beyond that are easily recognized. There are 9 model trains that traverse their way through the different landscapes. 

Tips/Highlights:

+Tickets- You will need to purchase a ticket to the Eiteljorg Museum. This is considered an exhibit.

+Parking- Is free in the underground West street parking garage; however, make sure to get a validated ticket from the front desk.  As of Nov 2017- They are still working on maintenance in the garage, so is chunk of spaces blocked out.


+ Stroller Parking - Please be kind to other sand park you strollers prior to entry into the exhibit in the marked area. The space inside, while ample, I could see getting extremely tight with a bunch of people and kids running around enjoying the exhibit

+Guides/ Find the "Hidden" Items - Upon entry there are large cards that are geared towards kids that gives them fun information and tries to keep them engaged with the exhibit by spotting specific items in each section

+ The Displays - They are well crafted and you can tell the amount of time and attention to detail was extremely consuming.  The displays were but together using natural materials, so you will see a lot of wood. 

+ Noise - This may not be of concern to some; however, I could see certain kids, especially really young ones, possibly getting easily excited by the train noise and commotion of people taking photos possibly overwhelming. I would recommend going on a non-crowded day.
After 2000 miles and a week of driving through Nevada, Montana and Idaho, this $7.99 wash thoroughly removed the layer of squished flying insects on the front bumper. Impressive!

So I'm writing this review for The Man...because personally I dislike Taco Bell food.  So yeah...

The Man gives this place 4 stars because:
- They're fast
- They're friendly
- They never get his order wrong

I am really glad that I decided to check out Icesmile. I chose this location for a quick date night with my boyfriend and we didn't go wrong. There were about 5 employees in the ice cream shop and we both received our ice cream within 8 minutes. I ordered the strawberry graham ice cream and my boyfriend ordered the monkey lover. The presentation of my ice cream was not very appealing  but it was delicious nonetheless, and my boyfriend scarfed his ice cream down faster than I did. With a lot of choices for flavor and toppings, everyone can find something that they like.
I would come here again.

The parking is terrible at Kabuki. They only have 2 stalls behind the Garneau building. But they apparently have a few more in the residential further west. You have to check their website for the exact location of their stalls or pick up one of their brochures at the restaurant.

Once you manage parking and go inside, the restaurant is quite unique in terms of their decor. It's quite simplistic but there is a giant cherry blossom tree in the center decorated with lights, which create a romantic atmosphere for the place. The walls are painted a greenish-yellow with green bamboo accents.

And, of course, we care about the food. For friends who love eel, Kabuki boasts a huge selection of unagi dishes on their menu. Typically restaurants only offer the one and only unagi roll, but this restaurant offers a great variety. What attracted me most to the menu was a couple of flaming rolls. What was disappointing about the rolls was the rice was not rolled tight enough or was the wrong type of rice used(?) but it has that s

What we ordered:

- Flaming unagi roll (forgot the actual name) - It wasn't exactly flaming. They put the roll in a handmade tinfoil box and made it flame underneath the roll. The flame was for decor purposes and enhanced the roll in no way, which was a little disappointing for me, but still beautiful to look at.

- Dragon eye roll - Ahh, the Mikado-made famous dragon eye variation. The sauce was not bad, but comparing to Mikado's original sauce, it tastes nothing like it. What made this stand out for me was they mixed fake crab meat (pollock) in with the rice. It's hard to notice, but if you stop to look at your food carefully, you will notice the flaky addition. Very nice touch to make the roll unique.

- Sockeye salmon sashimi - A rare but classy addition to a few Japanese restaurants in Edmonton. This is the second place where I found this on the menu. At $16 ($4 more than regular salmon sashimi here), it's quite an expensive indulgence. But the sockeye salmon was VERY lean. The texture seemed a bit weird for me...almost flaky like cooked salmon. I haven't had too much experience with raw sockeye salmon, so I can't say whether this is the correct texture or not. But it definitely differs from my other experiences.

The service was good. Since this is quite a new restaurant, I think they just need more time to work it out, but definitely A+ for trying. We ordered tea, but instead of giving us a pot, like they did with the table of 4, we had to wait for the waiter to come by to get more tea...a slight inconvenience. I assume our waiter is the boss as he was super polite and always smiling. What impressed me the most was he bows every time he comes to our table and tells us to enjoy our food quite often. It was to the point where I thought he was starting to go hunchback from doing it too much. But definitely A+ on the Japanese mannerism. In fact, he caught me spying at his parking sheet on the wall and rushed to give me a brochure (for the parking spots) and told me about the website. Needs improvement in some areas, but great service still.

All in all, I would be willing to try this place out again some time in the later future.
The best pho I've tried in Reno. I'm picky, from SF, nothing matches SF but this pho is pretty damn good, favorite spot on a cold day

Whenever I do govt related copywork I bring it here.
It's always been good & they will take care of you, even if you accidentally print a letter size copy onto a 11x17, for example.

I had never been to a P.F. Chang's before. I was pleasantly surprised. It was nicer than i expected. Decorated nicely. I tried a little bit of what everyone else got and everything tastes very good. Nice menu selections. I didn't pay so I'm not sure how to gauge cost. But it did seem to be a tad high for a chain that isn't very unique. Our server was new she forgot some things and took forever to refill drinks. But she was fun, she'll do great once she has a few months under her belt:)
Great date night place! I can't say enough about the fried green tomatoes and the beet salad

Had the best wings I've ever tasted! Not overly sauced and the skin is crispy. The tacos were just as good, but sadly they no longer offer the combo (one of each kind of taco, chicken, beef, and pork). We spoke with the manager (I'm assuming) several times. She made it a priority to speak with all of the customers. The food here is definitely too notch. My only criticism is that our food was slow coming out. Our server was nice enough to inform us that an appetizer was not going to be ready until near when our entrees would be so we just cancelled it. Overall a great experience and worth the try. 
Came back again and got the Fries and Wings and they came right out! Love the people and love the food.

I'm usually skeptical when a restaurant is new and only has a few reviews, but figured I'd give Wise Guy's a shot.

I was not disappointed. Wise Guy's is good cheap and bad for you comfort food type of joint.

I got the Philly cheese steak. It was pretty good. Not a tops in Philly spot, but up their at the top of the regular Joe's spots.

I also got the Wise Guys fries. They are good fries. Then addition of melted American and cheese wiz made it better. A lot of it was on the bottom through. They could have done a better job melting it on top. The jalapeno peppers were nice. The bacon, to my surprise, was two whole strips of tasty bacon. As nice as fresh strips are, I actually wish it was more of an in bits type of deal. It's kind of hard to eat the whole bacon with the fries.

I also got the mac n cheese bites. These could do no wrong. The worst thing about them, there were not enough. And, they could have been bigger. But mac n cheese baked inside fried bread crumbs is heaven.

There's lots of good looking items on their "I don't know what to choose" menu. So much that looks good, and makes you feel just a little guilty eating.

But hey, we all need a little guilty pleasure in our lives.

Update: I had to drop Wise Guys to three stars (from four) after having their pizza. I have no idea what those talking their pizza up are talking about. I'm a New Yorker, so perhaps I am a little more picky. But, it was passable at best. I do not recommend it. You want pizza, go to Colonial.

Update 2: So, it turns out the pizza wasn't as bad as it seemed. The problem was it was under cooked. When I reheated the pizza and made sure it was well done, it was actually pretty tasty. Still no Colonial, but not bad by any means.

I've never been to a Village Inn, as we don't have one near us, but have heard about their famous pies.

We were greeted by Chelsea, a very personable waitress. The hostess/other waitress was friendly as well. I enjoyed talking with her and used some of her suggestions in my ordering.

She was really helpful in telling us about other area attractions and restaurants that are good (Michael's grill has halibut, for example). That's nice to have good conversation, especially if you are learning the area.

I think my husband actually likes this place better than our local Denny's (which is saying a lot...he's obsessed with Denny's, for some odd reason).

The food was delectable, reminiscent of my days as a child going to the local HoJo's up north, only the decor is a brown and orange instead of aqua and peach.

Not sure  why the restaurant only had one other patron, maybe because we went at 3 pm on a weekday. It's certainly not for lack of service, because they obviously can cook and serve with a smile!

Will definitely be back.

The absolute WORST service EVER... which is so sad because the food really is delicious, but the service is seriously soooo bad it overshadows how good the food is. It's almost comical how AWFUL the service is at the Exton location... almost, like if it wasn't actually as bad as it it.  They should be awarded for their consistently beyond-terrible service!
We've been to the Royersford location also- service and food are better there as long as you don't mind the occasional cockroach.

I go in for a high mileage oil change and I had a bead seal leaking on front tire. Tire rotation is included in the service. I specifically ask for my tires to be rotated because the bead seal likes to unseat on an F350 work van with a tight turning ratio when carrying a load. Turns out they intentionally marked NO to the tire rotation in the service package so they could add it as a separate line item and charge me for it. They did charge me for it but never even did the tire rotation. I had to go back to get the refund of my money and sit there to watch and make sure they did the rotation. Then they didn't even tighten all the lugs down. And they didn't leak test it, still have the problem. And you can't even blame this on one guy or the other. The mechanic didn't want to do his job and the desk guy tried to scam me with fraudulent charges. I will not go back.

DECEPTIVE PRACTICES

Although the grooming and cut done on my dog was good, I was highly disappointed that when I took my dog here for the 1st time they did not ask for proof of shots nor her vet's name. Makes me wonder about their safety standards therefore I will not be returning there with my dog.

If you are looking for high quality and affordable sushi. you can not beat Sushiya. The place recently changed owners and the new owners are doing an amazing job! it is a family run store and they are working hard to turn this place around. 

I have been there 3 times this week, every time I try something different and it is all very good. The company I work for is about to use them to do our catering. 

Hard working owners, fresh fish, well priced. If you live in IV or Goleta it is a no brainer. If you live in Santa Barbara it is worth the trip.

One of those "hole in the wall" delicacies that locals keep referring too. The atmosphere is rather interesting being that it's restaurant seating area is fused with the grocery shopping section. So ideally a customer could go grocery shopping while watching you eat. Two televisions play on mute in each corner as you listen to a rather interesting genre of music. There appears to be an official seating area that's much more appealing to the eye but appeared to be in use for overflowing crowds. 

I had #35. Shish Tawoo Plate. If you like Chicken, then GET THIS PLATE! Better than #33. Chicken Kabab Plate. You heard it here from the mouth of the goat. 

The establishment has some reasonably priced dishes as well which is a plus!

Great for quick get togethers or quick lunch. :)
Might be the best sushi I've had since moving to the city over a year ago.  The waiter was helpful and we loved the atmosphere.  Already have another reservation.
Fantastic space, fresh ingredients, delightful service. Loved it.

I have two small kids and family that lives in Ventura, so the Padaro is a regular meeting place to let the kids play in the sandbox while we enjoy a good burger and local craft brew.  I've been once since the new ownership and it still seems just as good as before.  I wouldn't stray too far from burgers and salads, those are good but mixed reviews on some of the seafood.  Beer is good, and did I mention the kids entertain themselves in the sandbox so you can enjoy an adult conversation?

BEST CHILI EVER!!!! If you like old west style restaurants then you must stop by. The drive is a little far because this place is in the middle of the mountains, the drive is worth it's, very scenic and enjoyable. The restaurant itself is very small, and you might have to wait depending on how much people they have. the place is so nice that we didn't mind waiting, we sat outside on  a bench enjoying nature. Going to this restaurant is an experience like no other.
This is currently my favorite place for takeout! It's priced fairly, delicious and they package it so nicely.

Truly a joy!  The location makes you feel like you are going on a little adventure.  It is quaint and although the desirable tables are near the window overlooking the swamp, no seat is a bad one.  The services are professional and personable and the food is delicious.  This restaurant is perfect for special occasions and can accommodate large parties.

Bon appetit!

Stopped in here after we couldn't get poboys from killer's. We got the "taste of Louisiana" three plate consisting of gumbo and rice, crawfish etouffe, and jambalaya. We look got the shrimp poboy. We weren't happy with the poboy here but the three sampler platter was pretty good. The gumbo wasn't good until we added Louisiana hot sauce tho. Service wasn't very good. We asked for a side of spicy mayo sauce and it took literally 13 min. They kept coming to our table with the wrong order. It was difficult to flag someone down to get our check. Overall wouldn't come again.

I would give this business zero stars if that were an option.  

My husband and I came in this store three times looking at a desk.  The first time was just to get measurements and make sure ti would fit in his office.  The second time was two weeks later to discuss the price - non-negotiable! The man said they had just gotten the desk in.  That was not true.  We had seen it previously when getting measurements.  Today we were driving by and decided to stop in.  Again, the price was absolutely non-negotiable.  I am sorry.  This is a thrift store.  This isn't a high end furniture store. The negotiation wasn't anything crazy or outlandish.  We had the cash in our wallet.  It would have been a simple, easy, cash sale.  

With my harsh review comes some suggestions.  The first thing this store needs to do is to consider the amount the client wants to offer and discuss the offer. I know this is a thrift store and customer service isn't paramount but at least engage the customer about what they are looking for. Awful business model! it should feel like a win/win situation for both the business and the client.  

I have not written a negative review before but feel this one is warranted. I am amazed this business sells anything. Just for the record, we went to Consign Furniture by Target.  The man took our offer to the front desk.  With a tinch of haggling, it was accepted and we know have a better desk that the original one at Recycled Furniture.

Delicious plates! Well stocked bar and a nice array of beers make this Rustic corner spot a must go to. You can tell the chef has a great grasp of food and also a wonderful, exciting and colorful concept for their dishes. Happy hour specials are great too!

We had yummy sandwiches, drinks and shared a huge slice of millionaire cake for lunch.  Although the sandwiches were tasty, neither of us cared for the mustard they used. Also, the "salad" that came with the sandwiches was difficult to navigate. Cake was yummy. Very expensive for what we got.

Can't thank the team at MO's enough for the outstanding customer service they displayed when I called from out of state to prepay for my mom's Birthday dinner.  She and her husband said not only did the staff act as if they were waiting for them to arrive, made them feel very special, but it was also the best dining experience they have ever had.  Wonderful meal and terrific service by JR.  thank you Mo's!

Thank u Kayla at the customer service counter!!!!! she really made it her goal to find a 2 year old receipt that I tried to get from the slidell location with the associate that said she couldn't find on the first search

Upon reading my previous review, the owner called me to apologize for his behavior.  The staff also sent us a present to commemorate our event, which was lovely.  I do believe they normally have outstanding service, but I caught them on a bad day.
The burger and wings where amazing! The down fall the drinks could have been colder especially the frozen drinks.
THE BEST TACOS!! good wings and great gyros..this place ROCKS..
This place is awesome. The pizza comes out thin but crispy and its authentic brick oven. Awesome craft beer selection and knowledgable bar tenders. I will be back a thousand times.

Great location - for me, anyway - located near Ballas and Conway. Two separate parks occupying two and a half acres await small and large dogs, although I did take my five pound chihuahua in to run with the big dogs. She was not impressed. Nevertheless, my Aussie mix loves it. The park provides a huge fenced area replete with trees and manicured lawn. During warm weather, two wading pools are available for overheated pooches, and the community of dog guardians is very good about making sure the water in the pools is changed and kept fresh - the water bowls, too. There are many regulars frequenting the place and it's easy to strike up a conversation. Most of the dogs are very well behaved and friendly with the occasional would-be alpha trying to hump your dog and steal its toy.

I've probably been here 15-20 times. EVERY SINGLE TIME the food is delicious, the service is stellar, the entire experience is spectacular.  All the servers work as a team and everybody takes care of you. They all make you feel like family. Even the owner, Hope gets involved and makes sure that everything is perfect. Sometimes I'm not sure why I go anywhere else. Everything else nearby pales in comparison - and believe me, I've been to them all!
This place is like going to your best friend's house where they take care of every little detail and you feel so at home and everything is so scrumptious - yet you don't have to do a single thing except show up, sit down and enjoy!
There's always something new offered as a special and the menu items are very reasonably priced. 
Sometimes I feel guilty that I'm not paying more for these delectable meals. And that's no exaggeration!

Great new place in Belleair to hang out, meet people, drink coffee and have deserts. My favorite is the Cortada served hot with a non gluten brownie. 

Breakfast items served too. Quiche and breakfast wraps.
Love this store!!! So many wonderful things for children!! Love to shop here for unusual gifts for friends!! I will always shop here first for Grandchildren and shower gifts! Love it!
Great, moderately priced, and a 2-for-1 coupon made for an excellent meal. Service was excellent, chipper servers abound. Melon gazpacho and scallops impressed me greatly.

Fabulous food and fantastic service!  We had the Nola Bites, Mufaletta, Crawfish Etouffee, and a side of the cheese grits - I didn't want to stop eating!  Carl, our server, kept things lively and entertaining without being obnoxious.  I don't normally write reviews and tonight's meal made me take the time to say, "Kudos Creole House!  Best dinner we've had in a long time!"

this place is reeeeallllyyy unorganized and messy. i couldn't find anything because it wasn't in alphabetical order. what good is a bookstore if you can't find anything!!! also, the upstairs is hot as hell and i almost passed out. the aisles are extremely tiny, so if you're in a wheelchair, or overweight, you won't fit. i have no idea if the prices were fair, because there wasn't a price on a single book.

They have combination deals that make rolls and sushi super cheap! The rolls are definitely on the smaller side, so you'll need to order up on the combination deal if you want to get full. Sashimi was actually more fresh than I thought it would be, considering the price! 

Also, the joint is sort of small, and the service is slow, but the place is BYO, so you can just head downstairs and bring up some beers while you're waiting.

Wow, found this place looking for brunch near Rittenhouse Square. The staff are friendly, the coffee amazing.  My friend mentioned their popcorn and we found out that they only serve it at lunch. I am from Massachusetts, so I won't be able to come back, but they brought some popcorn out!!! And the smoked salmon eggs Benedict were delicious!

They are a new neighborhood small business gem that is worth supporting! The owners are incredibly friendly and inviting. The facility is bright and clean. I've been here for a manicure and pedicure and have been pleased with both experiences! If you are looking for a new "go to" nail place, I'd certainly recommend them!

I know it's shameful, but I went over 10 years without going to the dentist. I didn't have any problems(or dental insurance) so I just didn't feel the need. Well...turns out I had 4 cavities :/ In the past, I dreaded dentist visits. Dr. Nabors has such a gentle touch, not even the needle hurt! And it was affordable enough that I could pay with cash. If I had known that going to the dentist didn't have to be scary I would've gone years ago. Now I'm in every 6 months for a cleaning like a good little girl and everything is great!! Andrea is my hygienist and she is gentle as well. I'm a big baby and she deals with the weird faces I make. She also whitens my teeth and they look sparkly and stay white for months after!! The office staff is always friendly and accommodating. Love this place!!

This place smells like a pile of old pissy diapers.  As soon as I walked in the door I was overcome by the odor.  I had to meet some people here so I did not have a choice but to stay.  I was the first person there so I chose a table nearest to Prater Blvd.  The smell was less noticeable there.  I remembered the last time I had come to this restaurant there was the same smell so we left without eating.  I could not eat my meal because of the urine stench. GROSS!!!!
I believe the owner greeted me at the door. She was rude and threatened service if I didn't get gel. The quality received is not worth the price.

You have 300+ other reviews to read about this place. Not sure why you're taking the time to read mine, but I'm glad you are so here's what I have to say about it, without trying to take too much of your time:
-waited about 20 minutes for a tiny tiny table for 2
-I ordered the Ranchero Eggs  (Mexican style incase you did not know). I am Latina. I KNOW how to make some good damn Mexican style eggs
-Took them about 25 minutes to bring it to us.
-I asked for the eggs over easy. They brought them to me scrambled. That's a no-no.
-They took it back and brought me my right dish. By this time, my boyfriend has finished his breakfast.
-Too expensive for what it is. I can make it better for less.
-THE JUICES ARE LIKE $5+ WHAT?!?!?!?!?!
-I REFUSE TO PAY 5 DOLLARS FOR ORANGE JUICE. NO WAY JOSE. 
-Won't be back. But I might give the uptown location a try. Still don't like their prices.

Picked up a large with sausage, green peppers, and black olives the cost $9.50. The only good thing about the pizza was the crust and the price. As another reviewer mentioned, they don't even out the dough so there was substantial more at the top of the pizza while the bottom was falling apart with the ingredients. The pizza was not hot, even after warming it for 20 seconds, very soggy, and the toppings were horrible (looks like they don't use real sausage). Pizza was very inconsistent, such as not being uniformly warm, sloppy, thin sauce, and cheese that easily slide off the pizza. Some of the guys look like they are in drugs, which is not surprising due to the poor quality of their pizza. This was one of the worst pizzas I have ever eaten! Folks that think this pizza is good need to have their head examined! I doubt those folks travel much outside the country let alone the local area. Delco standards are so low....:(

Awesome service.  INCREDIBLE FOOD AND BEER!

Like others have said, we walked in the front door, and the hostess was several booths beyond.  

Friendly and quick service. if your want a unique take on a traditional burger, give this place a shot!

A perfectly cooked burger and all the fixings INSIDE a thinner pizza crust!!. DELICIOUS!!!! Best food yet!!

My wife and I have been wanting to eat here so we did about 2pm one day. No lines no crowds. The venison stuffed meatballs were crazy good with flavor though they could have been a little hotter temperature wise. Clearly made ahead of time and heated up.

As an entree I had the Cajun chicken pasta which was more than enough and was spectacular as far as flavor goes. 

My wife had some sort of crab cake which she liked as well. Will be back.

I eat sushi constantly and I wanted to try a new place! This place was reasonably priced and very fresh! The best part was now quick the service was. Everyone was super friendly and the rolls were large and in charge! Started out with the app of gyoza was delicious very juicy! The Asahi special roll was amazing, it's deep fried and huge! The rainbow roll was topped with fresh salmon and tuna and white fish! The spicy crunchy salmon was good the only thing was the rock n roll with the shrimp tempura I feel was missing more of the actual shrimp filling! Other than that I will be going back for sure!

I brought my 9 year il daughter in to share a day of manis and pedis. They were fairly busy for a Sunday afternoon. We both received classic spa pedicures. My daughter had a manicure and chose designs for her fingers and nails. Everyone was friendly. We did have to wait about 10 mins but we were walk ins so we did not mind. The prices seems comparable to the area salons. The facility was clean and try did sterilize all the equipment before use. They do accept charge/debit but with a $15 minimum... And tips have to be cash only. I was satisfied with the pedicure but a little more care on cut downs would be nicer. I did get nicked 3 different places. We would most likely return.

I went on a Sunday around noon and there was a line to get a table. Apparently, that's how the crowd is all the time. I'd heard good things about Biscuits, but I would end up being disappointed.

I ordered a breakfast burrito ($8.00). The menu stated that it would be filled with chorizo, potatoes and eggs, but half of the tortilla was filled with onions and peppers, which I do not like. There were hardly any eggs in the burrito. The chorizo was bland - the worst chorizo that I've ever had.

The server was super nice, but the food was blah. I won't be going back.
We love this movie theater/ bar/ restaurant. Great drinks, friendly service and good food.  We can only recommend this place!!
I don't want to bash the heck out of this place with my review and frankly this place is not worth the time it takes.  Let me just say this; I WILL NEVER BE BACK HERE AGAIN!!!  IT WAS HORRIBLE

What a great shop!

I have been there several times and I only have good things to say about it.

The store is family owned and all of the family members that work there are very friendly and knowledgeable about their product. Ask them anything!

The selection of spices is huge! I have browsed there for over and hour, looking at all of their items. Just to give you an idea, they have dozens of different salts and peppers alone! Lots of fun and unique items as well, like spicy Mayan chocolate (great for brownies with a kick), and rose water.

I love the freeze-dried corn that they sell, try it!

Fun, funky, and fresh all around. The food was standard poke bowl fare. I was impressed by the vareity of toppings and their quality. Every bowl will pack a lot of flavor with the amount of sauce and toppings they use. Portions were to be expected for upscale fast casual places. 

It may be a little confusing for someone first walking in. There's no sign about where to order so go the end of the bar. And if you are not familiar with poke, the build your own style might be confusing. Feel free to ask them for guidance. The staff is friendly and helpful. The venue is clean and modern. Great local staple!

I would not recommend the bubble tea. The quantity of boba was really high for the little amount of milk tea and ice. It's perfect if you really like a lot of boba.

I came in on a Sunday lunch hour to order to go..They weren't that busy, about five people at the bar and two tables. Staff greeted me right away and handed  their menu. I placed my order which included 3 long rolls (san Francisco, mountain, & Philadelphia) and two appetizers (pot stickers & calamaris). It took nearly 45 minutes until I got my order. To top it off, they forgot my calamaris!! 

The rolls were poorly wrapped. Once you pick it up, it crumbles! Food was average but wished I had a better experience!

India Palace has saved my life several times, both due to its easily accessible location in the International Marketplace just off 65, and the fact that it opens for dinner starting at 5pm.  They also have FIFTEEN vegetarian entrees, plus a super delicious vegetable biryani.  Once seated you will be treated with water, menus, a basket of papadum, and an assortment of chutneys (mint, onion, and tamarind) which you will happily devour while deciding what to order.

What you should get:
*GARLIC NAAN (if you don't try this without a very good reason, I will probably unfriend you)
*Paneer chilli (delicious cheese cubes in a rich, spicy, tomato-based sauce - my favorite)
*Nav ratan korma (veggies cooked with herbs, cashews, raisins - also fantastic)
*Aloo mattar (peas and potatoes with a spicy sauce - my potato-loving husband's go-to dish)

The staff are very helpful and I've taken their advice on several occasions when I've been overwhelmed by the options - it's good advice.  Munch on!

The hotel staff at the Peppermill is pretty AWESOME. Particularly Marty Babione, I had left my jacket in my room and didn't remember until I was half way home. When I got home I called the hotel and they had the jacket in lost and found. I spoke to Marty and he told me no problem we found it and will ship it back to you today at our expense....WOW.....that's great service. I always enjoy my stay at the Peppermill, Marty made it even better.

Great dining experience.  Smokey Old Fashion is a must as is the Stuffed Grouper. Blackened scallops were an awesome start.  Extremely friendly and helpful wait staff.  Views were amazing and our waiter was amazing.
Food was delicious!!  Family owned business, service was a little slow, but the food was definitely worth the wait!!

Came in for the first time to fix the band on my Cartier watch and replace the battery in my Balmain watch. The owner and assistant barely welcomed me and seemed to act like I couldn't afford to be in there (my Cartier watch is well over $15k). I asked if they could look at it before I dropped them off and seemed annoyed to walk away from a customer with a Breitling watch. They gave a quick answer that he couldn't fix the band and refused to give any recommendations on where to take it. His exact words were "I don't know any reputable jewelers, but I can't fix it". I allowed them to replace the battery in my Balmain watch but I most likely won't be back due to the poor customer service. I will take my watch to be repaired by a jeweler who can give me more than a minute of their time.

This Target is always clean and the staff is usually very helpful. 

What can I say, Target is my guilty pleasure and I live that I get 5% off with my Target Red Card! Love it!
Decent beer selection... that's all I was looking for.  Other than that I try to avoid Mobil's.  QT is more my style.

This place is UNTOUCHABLE if you want a great environment to enjoy the best sushi in PA. They are clean, very quick with service and just impeccable. I have been all over the area and this is the one I continue to come back to. The outdoor seating is wonderful and there is an area that is under a roof so you can enjoy the outdoors even if the weather is a bit dreary. And the one thing that amazes me is no matter how full the parking lot seems they WITHOUT FAIL are extremely speedy no matter how many customers they have. I wish I could give more than 5 stars.  TOP NOTCH!
Such nice staff and overall great hotel.  Special shout out to Rhonda, what an angel, helping me figure out directions and transportation!

Food gets 5 stars! However, the service by our waiter was only a 3, and that's because we saw him only 3 times.  The busser was much more attentive to our needs, so we gave him a portion of the server's tip.  I will go back because the food was great!  It was a Saturday for brunch. Everyone at our table tried something different--drop biscuits (3) served with jam and gravy, skillet, veggie Benedict, and breakfast Reuben.  The Bloody Mary bar included just about every ingredient you could need.

Sadist behind counter
sadist behind the counter indeed.
want to be treated like crap?  come shop here.

I absolutely loved this. We parked at opry mills near the movie theatre and just walked over. It was seriously impressive and worth all the hassle of the ridiculous traffic. So fancy inside and so many great photo ops! Definitely go on your visit to Nashville!

First and foremost, this place is worth the wait. If you are planning to eat here, and didn't come before opening, expect at least a 20-30 minute wait if you're lucky. We got here right when the doors opened and only had to wait 20 minutes to get seated. The food is everything it's hyped up to be, and the service was really great. So, as said earlier, this place is worth the wait.

Wonderful, Wonderful experience !!!
Jim, Matt and the whole Service Team were not only Professional, but NICE !!!
They took care of me during a very difficult time.
Thanks again !!!

My review is primarily about delivery and customer service.  

Delivery.
I have attempted (by myself and with friends/family) to have Reginelli's delivered to my house on four separate occasions in the last year.  The first time it came within the stated time frame and was ok, so we continued to order.  The last three times I've ordered Reginelli's they always say that delivery will be about 45 minutes (thats ok) but when the hour mark occurs I usually give them a call to ask as to the status of my order.  They always say, "We're sorry, we suddenly got really busy, its on its way."  (This wasn't on a weekend, holiday or Mardi Gras, so go figure about the sudden rush)

...

My pizza finally arrived somewhere around the 2 hr mark and was stone cold (all three times).  The first time I called them back to complain and the lady on the phone basically said, "We're sorry, we'll replace it but it will be at least hour and a half before we get it to you."   The last two times, I didn't even bother to call.  

If a pizza delivery comes late once, thats understandable, it does happen, but when it happens three times with the same company then its time to call someone else.

So glad Yelp reviews brought me here. Sat at the bar by myself hit dinner. Friendly, attentive bartender. Nice cocktail list. The shrimp risotto was perfection! Creamy, garlicky, perfectly cooked, fresh shrimp.  Would order again in a heartbeat. No outdoor seating but lovely views of the water. Would be a wonderful spot for date night.
Dawn Patrol is one of our favorite breakfast spots in SB! We come every time we visit-their build your own hash is delicious and the coffee is solid. Everything is fresh and tasty.
Came back to try the kimbap, it was full of flavour and packed full. Also a great value, you get a lot for the price. Friendly staff as well.

I have used Markatos for over a year. Nicole is an outstanding service manager. From the start Nicole has been a professional and listens to the customer. I was impressed when Markatos did an initial in-person quote. I had called a few other firms and was shocked to get a huge estimate over the phone based on square footage. My husband and I are the only occupants so the spare rooms and bathrooms are hardly used. Markatos takes that into account and that will definitely save you money.

Markatos sticks to a schedule pretty well. For routine service,once assigned a date/time the team never cancels or shifts days. On occasion, hours may shift but it is not a big deal. 

Great with pets! My dogs are treated exceptionally well and let out of crates while they are there. The dog are put back in the crate afterward. Markatos does a great job removing pet hair....amazing.

The office management is exceptionally hardworking and accomodating. If I had to change or cancel a service they are top notch....Jo Ann thanks!

Trustworthy .Period. We have never had a problem with things missing or stolen. Often leave them unattended and its never a problem. 

Recently, I noticed a few items were not cleaned as well as I am used to. 
I let Nicole know and the next day she had a schedule in place to re-clean FREE of charge! She also took it as opportunity to re-train the team.
The house looks amazing.

Give Markatos HONEST feedback its how they improve!
Thanks Markatos!
Dina and Jim
They do not skimp on their sandwiches here. Solid 5 inches in diameter with tons of bacon and cheese. Not especially clean but definitely tasty.

I love the whole concept. We had such a great experience here. The food was delicious. Our waiter was the best. We ordered cheesecake which was even better. I can't wait to come on the day they make cinnamon rolls. We will defiantly be back.

I really do like this Shop Rite.  The prices and hours are great, and the service is generally decent.  The deli has usually has a special, which is a nice surprise everytime (like turkey for $3.99/lb!), and I always get samples of meats and cheeses to snack on while I wait for my order.  The bakery is usually well-stocked although the donut selection is not as fantastic as Giant's; they do have the essentials, though.  The store itself isn't the most well-organized but it has everything at relatively low prices.  Plus, if you shop on a Sunday morning, they have complimentary coffee, danishes, bagels, and cookies, which is a really nice gesture, I think.  I've also noticed that service has gotten a lot better over the years.  They also have an entire aisle dedicated to Mexican groceries, too, which most other surrounding groceries stores don't have.
Its a great place to shop for produce but a lot of is not actually from local growers see the link to news article http://www.independent.com/news/2013/jan/31/farmers-market-harvests-discontent/

Update: We've returned several times since my original post-renovation review. The service has been more efficient, and I've bumped it back up to a 5.

This is the older post:

The renovation is lovely, the coffee still the same, but it's 3:30 with the Craft Fair going on at Rittenhouse, and LaColombe has the most inefficient team working the bar. Incredibly inefficient and kind of scattered. 

The line, which usually moves really quickly, just crawled.

I usually get a sidecar iced coffee. This time the espresso sidecar was filled nearly to the top of the glass.  It is usually just a half-inch.

Is it okay to say this is my favorite brunch spot even though all I've ever had here is their grits? I would definitely try one of their other courses and I'm pretty sure they're amazing, but it is so hard to not get my favorite thing off their menu! Their portion is so huge, i usually share it with another person (if I'm not being greedy)! You can literally top anything onto your dish and they vary from .50 cents to 1.00 dollar.  I love to add on avocados, red bell peppers, bacon, cheddar, and mushrooms! Their grits are incredible, it is not grainy nor watery. It's just perfect. I can go on and on. but I'm pretty sure you get the point! 

Eventually, i will try their other dishes, but for now, it's all about their grits.

Here is another review on a great Barber shop. I travel the country every week and ever 2 or 3 weeks I try and find a barber shop to go a clean up and shave. I drove 20 miles to this shop and I wasn't disappointed at all! 

My barber was very dedicated and focused on giving me what I wanted and making it look good. Fresh fade, lined up, and straight razor shave. All for $20 bucks. You can't beat it. I'm not sure what the normal rate is but for what I got $20 was a great deal. I just had the same thing done 3 weeks ago at a shop in Dallas and it was $80. 

Very well done I'll be back next time I'm in town. Thanks.

I took my sister here at 8pm on a Sunday night when all other Urgent Cares were closed as she had terrible flu symptoms. I forgot my wallet at my dorm and they allowed us to leave and come back when we realized we could pay with a card number obtained over the phone. My sister was seen within 10 minutes. The nurse was thorough, extremely nice, and very sweet, as was the doctor who came in after. I've never experienced such positive, thorough care from an urgent care facility, nor trusted the providers there more. They were thoughtful enough to write us a script rather than send it to a pharmacy as some have had Tamaflu shortages. Thankful that a rough night was made much better by their amazing service!

I came here with my sister and niece so they can buy souvenirs before heading back home.  The lady working was nice to my niece.  There was nothing that really stood out in this store.  They ended up getting some shirts and keychains.

Bourbon flights are pricey but well worth it if you're a whiskey fan.  Spent a night with live music and a couple of friends going through about 4 different flights, and was not dissapointed.   Whiskey burned good, the band played well, and the general crowd was friendly and comfortable.  

Haven't been able to get to the game tables upstairs, having only gone on weekend nights, but this would make for a fine happy hour stop for those as well.

The place is on the small size but the food is cheap and good. I would avoid the smoothies and bubbles. You can taste the powder in the fruit smoothie and bubbles are hard. You have to look carefully when driving down the street you may pass it

Not bad but not great. A restaurant that wants to be more but the staff is just not inspired to deliver. Spotty service most of the time and food that can be awesome (like those skillet mussels) or average to bad, like most pasta dishes. Steaks are good but side dishes are blah. Best part is the Sinatra Bar, great atmosphere and unique in this area. Do not go if you want to hear the people at your table...

Well my boyfriend and I gave Cheddars a second chance recently, because the time before we had awful service. The food has always been pretty good and that's why we choose to go back. We had great service this time and the drinks and food were great!! The only complaint I would have is that we ordered an appetizer and barely had the chance to eat any of it before our dinner came out. We were still charged for the appetizer. All and all its reasonable and family friendly place to go!

The Opa! at WEM is worlds apart from the others; definitely the best Greek fast food spot in town. I get the #5 with the pita wrap and French Fries - yes, French fries. Not very Greek, I know. But seriously, these are no McCain potato sticks. They're close to the best I've ever had. You can also get a mean fried calamari plate here. Who knew?! 

I don't think the one on Whyte even serves appies like that. This franchise is run by Francis, a super sweet lady who takes pride in keeping a very clean restaurant. It has more the feel of an intimate little restaurant than a fast food chain. When I feel like Opa! I head to WEM. Their pita bread is so yummy and fresh and their tzatziki is to die for.

I was SO disappointed by this place! 

Normally I find places near the water to have fresh, albeit simple, delicious seafood, unfortunately it was not the case at this shanty by the sea.

The prices were super inflated and not all of their seafood was fresh, which should have been the first major indicator that our group should dine elsewhere.

I ordered the crab cakes, which arrived lukewarm and greasy; overall not very appetizing. 

I think next time I will skip the pier and go straight for a fresh clambake!

Our company has been using Buddy Heilig & Sons for years and we have always been happy with the service we receive. 

They are knowledgeable, courteous and their prices are fair. 

This is a local family owned company.

My sweetheart and I came here for a quick lunch on a weekend day. We were both in the mood for something different and wanted something quick and had a craving for something (somewhat) Asian. 

The place was pretty dead only one other table occupied. All other tables were clean and had no lingering bento boxes or empty soda bottles. Dirty tables is my biggest pet peeve in faster food establishments! 

We each ordered a Bento, mine with tempura and "dumplings" his with tempura and sushi. They both came out looking quite appetizing and very generous. 

The beef teriyaki tasted like roast beef sandwich meat with bottled teriyaki sauce. And the rice was cold and mushy. Likely over cooked! My dumplings were bland and I gave them to the BF to finish, the bento came with 3 and I only ate one. The small salad of carrot and bean sprouts were probably the best thing in the box. Actually no, the tempura yam was! It was light and not overly greasy, but still nothing to write home about. As for the fruit... Well... It was canned and all tasted the same, syrupy and canny! If that's even a word :-( 

Service was average and price was not equal to value. Sadly, I will not be back and would rather spend my $15 on Edo Japan or another fast food joint.
They limit your drinks not only that but bought a jalapeño mcchicken isn't it suppose to have jalapeños ? My fries were old

I have been to Le Saigon many times over the past five years. Never outstanding but good, predictable Vietnamese which was convenient. 
I got takeout and in opening the containers noticed several very long black hairs in two of the containers. I brought the food back and pointed out what I found. The owner seemed very reluctant to admit they may have originated at the restaurant. (I am blond btw)
I had to ask for a refund since he was not offering. Not only was finding hairs in my food nasty but the managers attitude was enough to prevent me from ever coming back. 
I will go to Bamboo the next time I have a craving for Vietnamese.

I've only been here once but I loved the omelet I got - Baja Omelet. The friend I went with LOVES Refuel so I imagine we will be going back soon. She loves the Huevos Rancheros and that's what I want to try next time. It's a small place, but luckily we didn't have to wait long after placing our order for a table. Definitely going to be one of my go-to spots for brunch.

Awesome place to hangout with friends.
Great Pizza with Great ingredients.
Excellent staff and service.

I will just highlight the pepperoni pizza.
The cheese was gooey. The pepperoni crispy. The Dough cook through and firm Great crust that had the great golden brown of bread. Sometimes burnt, but meh.

My go to place for fried seafood here in Nashville!  I LOVE, LOVE, LOVE the fried oysters and clam strips basket!  The seafood is always fresh and tasty!  On days when I'm "trying" to be good, I flip the menu over to their sushi offerings...the Green Goddess and the Shrimp Pad Thai are my faves!

This is my first visit to this gem and it will not be my last.  The chef and owner takes skill to a whole other level. The combination of flavors is nothing but genius.  The wait staff are all warm, friendly, and on it!  They gained a regular customer today.  Thank you, Wheel Cafe!

We were on the road and happy to find this local gem. It was easy to get to from 275 North...we just had to take an easy loop around. Plenty of parking. It was like walking into a simple chic Brooklyn Coffee Shop. Very friendly staff, locally sourced products. We had an iced green tea, regular coffee with their in house made simple syrup and mini chocolate and carrot cupcakes. We would definitely stop in again!

Simply the best selection. I like to pick up locally brewed beer when I'm traveling, and whenever I spot a Total Wine I know they'll have a great local selection. Friendly service, competitive prices.
Breakfast- good view, good service, food was just ok. Listening to the street musicians was a major perk of this place.

They were so friendly and quick. I was in and out in less than 10 minutes. I shopped around and their prices are the most reasonable in the city. This was my second time getting my cracked screen fixed and he replaced all the screws that the other person at the mall kiosk didn't take care of. He even through in a case for free. They were really nice. I mentioned yelp and got $5 off the price for my iPhone 5s screen. Great place!

We were only able to stay one night in the area so I was hoping the amenities of the hotel would make up for not being able to explore the area.  I was wrong.  I only gave 3 stars instead of 2 because the entire staff was incredibly nice.  First of all the place is a maze which we did end up laughing at.  There are signs but the signage is not good.  I can see where someone who stays there all the time might enjoy the place (if you can afford a higher end room).  For new-bees it was just about 18 hours of confusion.  We stayed in Magnolia and I loved the outdoor pool there (and it was close) but it closes at 6 and doesn't open till 10.  If you want to enjoy a pool you have to go somewhere else and even with all our exploring I never even noticed a sign for it.  It's summer, it's hot and people like to swim outdoors.  Check in was like moving cattle, check out at Magnolia was painless.  The room was adequate but nothing special, clean but a little dated.  Parking-I've stayed at some high end hotels and most validate parking for guests.  We valet parked for about 35 dollars but self parking with ta was still about 25 dollars.  Huge drawback.  In our situation we were stuck eating at the hotel.  We ended up eating at Jack Daniels which was very good.  Breakfast was another story.  The only restaurant available for breakfast was at the other end of the complex.  When you're hungry and need coffee the last thing you want to do is walk a country mile to eat. Again breakfast was an astronomical price for a good breakfast that would be half the price anywhere else.  Hate to say it but parking alone will probably keep me from staying there again, at this price I'll spend my money downtown.  That is of course you love a lot of green plants.  Not even that many interesting flowering plants.

Great towing experience! Brandon was the driver that came out to tow my truck and he made it such an easy and un-stressful situation. Took the upmost care of my truck as it was being loaded onto the truck, paperwork was easy and conversation to my destination was beyond interesting and entertaining. Great customer service, HIGHLY recommend Brandon and All Points Towing for any tow needs.

Lee is the man. I took my tailoring needs to another tailor only to be exceptionally disappointed by the work that was done. I brought the items to Lee and he fixed the problems. Not only is he great at what he does, he is a very honest and nice man.

Overpriced dinner.  They had 4 different pastas all with white sauce.  I thought each one would have a distinct flavor, but they all tasted the same. The variety is scarce, as they have a little bit of Mexican food, a bit of Chinese, Italian, and a bit of American cuisine. A bit being about about 3 -4 platters of each  country cuisine.  We came in as a group of 22, we asked to be seated as a group as we were celebrating our mothers 75th Birthday.  At the counter where you pay we were told "yes that is possible".  When we were escorted to the seating area we were told we would be in 3 different tables. The Hispanic female manager or lead escorter, stated  "it would be impossible to seat 22 people together". Her words were"there is no way I can put a long table for 22 people". I think it was laziness on her part.  If you are in a large group skip this place. It is overpriced, and you don't get what you pay for. By the way, the waiter gratuity must be payed when you pay for your dinner.

Two words: steak frites. So friggin good. And so is the chicken sandwich and the burger and the brunch. I haven't really gone wrong here yet, but I swing in specifically for the steak frites.

The staff is hit or miss. Some are incredibly friendly and others are too absorbed in personal conversations to worry about service. I'd give 5 stars if the service was more spot-on.

Fantastic French food.  We went here for a family member's birthday dinner last week and everything was fresh, well-portioned and perfectly executed.  I had French Onion Soup to start,  but I regretted not ordering something else because it is the classic version of the soup and it tasted good but ordinary.  Other member's of my dinner party really enjoyed their salads (Caesar is done tableside).  My entre, the pork shank, was outstanding.  Perfectly tender with a light but flavorful sauce. My wife, a picky vegetarian, really enjoyed the risotto.

The service was not great (we waited 20 minutes for dessert), but even with that blemish, this place is worth the prices.

My favorite pizza in St. Louis!
Me and the wife have been coming here for years and finally it is getting the notoriety it deserves. Its not "Chicago Style". The sauce has a bit of zip, but the kind that leaves you craving for more. I love the overall vibe of this bar. I know change is coming at Black Thorn, but I can't wait to see what is in store for them!
Ignore the reviews from last year (2015) unless you like mushy wings soaked in butter. Why is it so hard to find good buffalo wings in the burbs?

I'm pleased to say that I tried the Elm Cafe Catering! 

The sandwiches were amazing and the bread was so fresh. I loved the muffins and can finally understand what all the hype is about. 

I had both a BLT and a vegetarian and I found the vegetarian most flavourful and packed with some delicious spice and tasty vegees.

I would definitely order from them again and the table was most pleased with the order too. Can't speak to the coffee as I just had a water.

Santa Barbara local here & I gotta say, Pizza Mizza has delicious thin crust, Italian style pizza. My favorite is the B.B.T Bacon, Basil and Tomato pizza...Crumbled bacon, tomatoes, basil, mozzarella cheese, and gorgonzola with a rosemary white sauce...just thinking about it makes my mouth water! 

They have an amazing promo right now too, buy one large pizza get one free everyday from 8pm to close, great if you're having some friends/family over.

I think the Black Sheep is my favorite in the city. They have yummy food (especially the fries), the first floor is lovely and bright when it's nice weather because of the big windows, and there are 3 floors so usually you can find a spot somewhere to have a drink.

Service was good and the food was good, but we felt very rushed.  Ordered the Chef tasting and then a drink assuming it would be 10-15 minutes until the first course arrived.  Our drinks arrived and 30 seconds later course one plus wine pairing.  We could not keep up with the wine and food pairing all evening.  Desert arrived and one bite in our check arrived.  When I am spending $115 a person for a tasting menu, I expect better kitchen management and should not have to sprint through the meal.  Our server was lovely and gentleman who seated us was polished and a restaurant vet.  

The food was good, but 5 out of 10 good.  The chef tasting which was recommended was obviously what the kitchen was prepared for.  Hot plates and warm to slightly cool food means advanced preparation and sorbet that has been hanging out in the blast chiller vs scooped to order.  Small, but crucial details.

Maybe this was an off night, but I am sure that when all things are firing properly, the food and experience is outstanding.  Doubt I will go back - hoped for more than good.

Well, I've been there for breakfast with their Bloody Mary bar and it was good. The food was great but the Bloody Mary bar has spice girl figures on it which i don't understand. Tonight, I went to the bar and ordered a Bloody Mary. It was white. That's right. It has so much horseradish in it that it was white and not red and they served it that way. It wasn't drinkable sadly.

Perfect place to spend an afternoon. Staff is great, prices are right (especially during happy hour) and the ambiance makes me wish there was a Bacchanal in my own hood. Meat and cheese plate not to be missed! Go now.

I fell upon this great little pub after a tour at ESP. What a find! Excellent food and interesting beers. The atmosphere was perfect. To the man at the table next to us (Saturday 12/28 about 2pm) with the blue sweater-if your date was not successful, PLEASE look me up!

Waited 45 minutes before they even offered to take our order. This was after we'd told our waiter we were ready to order and he said he'd "be right back" and then disappeared for twenty minutes. We spoke to the manager who gave us our two beers for free as well as a $10 credit. So - it's probably a nice place, but they've gotta work on training their staff. A lot.

Stumbled upon this place because we couldn't find another one and we were hungry!! I am so glad we did! IDelicious southern food- ordered the stuffed crab which was real crab deep fried that was so delicious - it came with mac & cheese and red beans and rice and homemade cornbread!! My mouth is still happy from this deliciousness. Couldn't stop eating it was so yummy!! Glad we came here and if ever back again, will make sure I go again!

McDonalds... What do you need to know?..   They serve the purpose. I'd complain about the inaudible Spanish fellow working the drive through but why would I expect much else..

Update:  they just charged me .25 cents for ranch..  I'm pretty wealthy actually but this stuff is so annoying.  I handed him a dollar, took 4 of them and walked to the trash can to throw away 3 of them as I only needed one.  I feel I made my point..

I've never felt the need to write a review until now... Was super excited to try this place with some coworkers one day last week. Arrived just after noon. There were 4 other tables and then us. It took 15 min to be offered anything besides water. We said we were n a bit of a hurry and would like to order. 10 min later he came back so we actually could... Another 25 min later when we were still without food ( salads and a flatbread and simple sandwich) we asked that our food be packaged to go.  Sadly the poor service (empty water bottle, forgotten ice tea) didn't stop there. The salads were not the ones we ordered and we were missing a sandwich! Looks cool on paper and at the actual location but I would recommend this place to an enemy. The food and service were sad.

Okay, people are too hard on this place.

I had a burger, a few beers, and the brussel sprouts.  The burger was excellent (though it was too huge for me to finish) and the brussel sprouts were good (though not great).  I think the best part of this place might be the space.  Even though the restaurant is pretty big, the atmosphere is home-like and cozy.

One of my favorite places to go and get my comfort food on ...  the only problem with my review will be that I only have an opinion on a couple menu items because I get the same thing every time !!!

Chicken Fingers, Chicken Fingers, Chicken Fingers -- and Fries .... and get their delicious Ranch dressing with both ... or just bring me a big vat and I'll bathe in it !!

And who doesn't love $1.75 beer in a can ?!?!?!?!

The service is always friendly if a teeny tiny bit slow but those darn chicken tenders will make you forget any delays !!

This market offers all sorts of foreign ingredients. If you need rice, noodles, soy sauce, etc, they probably have it here. This is not a fancy supermarket, but it's fascinating to walk around through the aisles to see what they offer.

They've remodeled recently and are now offering more items.

This is a must try, we come here frequent and we are never disappointed. Get there early so you get right in and don't have to wait. Decent selection of coffees, they have french press as well. Menu isn't huge which is nice so you can figure out what you want quickly. Food comes how in a decent time. I seem to always get the same thing (wilburt skillet) everytime I go cause it is amazing. Food just seems so fresh as well, friendly staff. You will leave full and a smile on your face.

This Bob Evans has consistently had issues with service.   I can't say how many times we've visited and had poor to non-existent service.   We visited recently on a Saturday night with only a few tables filled and sat for nearly 10 minutes without so much as a single server coming by.  We witnessed 3 servers standing around behind the counter, chatting, drinking sodas, doing nothing.  Meanwhile we noticed several tables filled with dirty dishes and several other tables with food and trash beneath them.   I have even ordered take-out and stood waiting at the counter for a long time before anyone even asked to help me.  Plus, the food in the past has been inconsistent at best.   I would say avoid this location and drive a few miles north on 37 if you want a Bob Evans meal!

The food is really good!! The service is less than average; I felt very rushed, unimportant, and cheated. Was shocked that the waitress withheld my coins when she gave me my change! Do they withhold change from all of their customers?!! Very disappointed.  Would she have done that to a well known food critic?

Will probably go back one more time eventually but will have lots of change with me to pay the EXACT amount! When it came time to give her tip, I applied the coins she withheld from me -they became part of her tip. Also, her tip dropped from my standard 25% to 15%. Flabbergasted.

Only tried donuts from here recently when my coworker brought some back.  On the website, they had some interesting flavors.  The donuts at softer since they are fresh.  My coworker said they moved slow in there and he had to wait a bit.  The donuts I had in the office were nothing special.  They were different but nothing about them really jumped out.  I'd actually be ok eating my store bought donut.

I find it hugely ironic that WF is trying to reposition itself as a 'value' food store right now when others (i.e. Trader Joe's up the street) have been doing that for years.  For value, go elsewhere.  For pretty food, lovely store displays and a feeling of smugness, check out Whole Foods.

Despite my snark, I have to admit that it's nice to see an enormous, clean and well stocked yuppie market in Reno finally.  Now that this town has been rated by National Geographic as a top outdoors place to live in, it needs the retail to support that (and I don't mean another REI).  For myself, I'm too cheap to look seriously at this place for my regular shopping needs, but for lunch and the odd stopover, it's awesome.   Beautiful produce, drool inducing cheese selections and a bakery that would break my budget if I bought everything that struck my fancy.

Plus it's proximity to the freeway (for those of us who do our shopping based on distance from the 395 or 80) makes it an ideal stop to/from the airport.

I really, really want to love this place. I went there again today, ordered a tartine and again it was burnt. Like black around the edges burnt. Honestly, I will probably still eat here because I enjoy their specials too, but I just can't get over the burnt toast, which has been consistent for several weeks running now. Burning toast is a mistake you make once or twice, fine. But not a mistake that you continually serve to your paying customers.

convenient location, cramped and dangerous parking lot. comprehensive selection-with no prices listed- arranged haphazardly in cramped aisles with no one in sight to help you find anything. drove over an hour on the basis of their websites assertion of 'in stock' on a highly rated seasonal (once  a year) beer...upon arrival was informed 'it'll be in next week' and 'we only get four cases anyway so we sell it by a lottery'..'but the website said'...'i just work here, i'm  not the owner'....and i just shop here and will never be back....

Craving some saucy meat over rice led me to my first visit here. I browse the menu and see roasted duck on the lunch special for about 5 bucks! My wife orders that. An egg roll and choice of soup is included. The hot and sour soup was not so hot and sour, but for the price of the lunch special, it was good enough. This is probably one of the better meals I've tasted for around five dollars. Forget the foot long!

I order the shrimp with scrambled eggs "Chinese" style. This style is  saucy as the eggs are whipped and cooked in gravy. It needed scallions and a touch of hot chili sauce. They didn't have the chili oil at the table. Maybe you have to request it. I did, however, ask for a little hot mustard on the side. Mixed with a touch of soy, I found the flavor I was looking for. The "American" style is fried like an omellete. 

With 2 sodas, tax and tip, it was a decent roasted duck and shrimp 20 dollar meal for 2. 

I look forward to trying their dim sum.

Mr. B's came highly recommended, and it did not disappoint!

The barbecued shrimp signature dish was to die for!  It was flavorful yet not too rich - we absolutely loved it!  The seafood gumbo was also excellent.  The Creole catfish was good, though not great.

We also enjoyed our brunch cocktails - I had the Bloody Mary (the $1.50 price point was incredible!) my friend had the Champagne Royal. 

The complimentary, hot out of the oven French bread was also amazing!

The service was wonderful, and the old school atmosphere was elegant and classy.  

Overall, a fabulous dining experience!

Well worth the wait! My mother and I went on a Monday morning around 9am. The wait was about 20 minutes. We thought we were going to have to wait for hours, but we were pleasantly surprised. The line moved really fast for us! Our waitress, Michelle, was incredibly welcoming and helpful. She made our experience at The Pancake Pantry top notch. Please do yourself a favor and order the sweet potato pancakes and pair them with the cinnamon cream. Out of this world!
You know you'll be getting a great meal when the menu is one page. Or, at least, that's how it should be. And that's how it is here. Our party enjoyed everything, and you will, too!
Since St. Louis City finally passed a half way decent smoking ordinance this place is now non-smoking. So the smoke is no longer an issue.

I'm not a sushi connoisseur, and admittedly my taste in the Japanese food craze is waning lately.  But, the food here is reasonably priced and tastes good.  Generally when my wife and I go here, we get a handful of rolls along with a full meal. 

Pro's:
1) Food: Good and reasonably priced.
2) Atmosphere: Very nice inside, but usually quite empty.
3) Wait staff: Friendly and no problems with order.
4) Parking: Easy.

Con's:
None really.
