The food was very tasty seasoned well and presentation was down hone style but appealing to the eyes. I was full but took home a slice of black forrest chocolate cherry cake which was great. I would highly recommend the restaurant and I will be back.

Food is ok, but the service was terrible. I sat without a refill on my drink for over 1/2 of my meal, and the price for the drink (tea) was over $2. I will never go back here. Not worth the money or my time.

We were here on a slow Friday night. We arrived around 8:45 and were seated promptly. It looked like they were slowly getting ready to close, there was only one table that seemed to have finished their meals. Waiter told us the specials, opened our wine and so far we're good! We ordered our appetizers and asked to have an other min to think about main course when he advised we shouldn't think too long since the kitchen is about to close. Understandable. After being served the apps it only took about another 10-15 min for them to bring the main course out, while we were still working on the apps. Also the busboy started lifting up the chairs while we were still eating, and the waiter seemed to call him and asked him to not do that while cstms are in the dining room. We were asked once if everything was ok, which I like because in other places you cannot hold a conversation without being interrupted like 5 times. We felt a little rushed, understandably because we were the only ones left by now and we were holding them there. If we would have been there a tad earlier I'm sure our dining experience might have been much better. Food was good, our mussels app had sand in them, so either they were not washed good, or they had sand on the inside so once they were cooked got out

I stop in on Wednesday at 2pm to try the all you can eat wings, and they were great. The Bartender/ waitress was very friendly she keep my drink refilled and alway had my next wing order in. The wings were hot and crispy, with about 10 flavor choices.

Great people, super fast service & the food is amazing! 
Homemade potato-bacon soup and homemade bread on a stellar sandwich. 
This cafe is in the heart of Historic Downtown Plant City and the setting is pure delight. 
Genuinely the best lunch I've had in a very long time. 
If you choose this place, you won't be sorry, I guarantee.  
Can you tell I enjoyed it?! Go there!

We had a wonderful stay with our large dog and 7 year daughter. The staff was outstanding, helping us with anything we needed. The room was comfortable and the breakfast far exceeded our expectations.

Overall FIVE stars!! The customer service was excellent and the food was one of a kind!  For starters we shared the seafood gumbo.  It was very tasty and full of flavor.  I had the portabello mushroom dish that was not too heavy and perfect for me.  My fiancé had the Mr. Bs BBQ shrimp!  This was our favorite!! Drank the sauce with a spoon afterwards.  For dessert we had homemade green apple sorbet!! It was a perfect way to end our night!  We wanted to eat here again, but the whole meal PLUS our drinks was $175!!

I dig this place. Great Cobb salad. Great flatbreads. Amazing BBQ sandwich. Super solid ingredients, pretty good service and a nice cafe environment. Not the cheapest place in the world, but it has delicious food. Always worth it.

Lovely evening! Service was great, food Delish, prices reasonable. We were never rushed and our server was very attentive and personable. Only downfall, very loud environment probably because there some large parties with many children. All in all good experience! Will return but will ask to be seated away from large parties.

So, i stumbled into this place because I bought a sharing spree voucher, and I'm glad I did!! I really liked the tequila lime chicken.it was fabulous! I brought a friend who is preggers and lets just say the queso made her very happy! It is definitely better than your average queso! Overall my experience was good. I liked the patio with the option of covered or not. It is a super cute little restaurant. My only complaint would be parking is a nightmare, but really that is no one's fault. It's in such a cute little neighborhood, and there's just no way around it.

We stay at the koa several times a year.  Always a great time.  Pool is wonderful and they keep it heated!  Staff is friendly and helpful.  Lots of amenities.  A very quite and peaceful place to vacation.  And its minutes from the beach.  Love this place, we have made many happy memories here.

Great service. I don't think I even waited more than a minute or two each time to have my glass of water refilled. Oysters for happy hour were great. Our servers suggestion of the Crawfish Bisque was a good one.

What a fantastic culinary adventure!  We went on a Saturday night and the place was jumping (loved the 80's jams they were pumping)but we still managed to grab two seats at the bar right away.  The bar is often my favorite place to eat in a restaurant as it offers a glimpse into the heart of the operation.  This place was no exception to that and we enjoyed watching the staff whip up small plate after small plate of some really creative fare.  The rice tots proved one of my favorites but we had many outstanding dishes. The beer selection was pretty decent and my wife enjoyed a Sake recommended be the very amicable Dustin who took great care of us.

In sum: AWESOME experience!  Go here for date night or with a few friends for a fun and memorable time.  The dishes will certainly keep you entertained.

burgers are great, so great that I can never get myself to try the other sandwiches on their menu.  get any combo of the burger you want, the meat is the best part.  and if your debating the thousand island on the village burger, its worth trying...good combination I would have never thought of.
the duck fries are average compared to other places, but they become excellent with the beer cheese sauce.
this place has limited seating so a wait is to be expected.  but they will text you when your table is up, so just plan on another activity for 30 to 90 minutes while your table is ready.

Stopped in for a quick lube, as I was overdue during my recent travels.  Thought everything went well until I looked in my driveway and found gear oil running down out of the rear differential and onto the concrete.  Looks like the help forgot to tighten the plug.....  lube express is now off my list of places to get a quick oil change....  this one is still costing me....

Good food.  Ribs, turkey ribs, greens.  Prefer their hot BBQ sauce.  

Will have to get a 2nd order of turkey ribs next time, as my 6 year old devoured them.

I almost don't want to post this because I want this place to stay a secret so I can always get an appointment.  I went today for the first time and called half an hour before.  They were very friendly and accommodated for me and my friend to come in and get a mani and pedi.  The salon has free parking, is very clean and really cute.  The lady doing my nails did a great job they turned out great!

For the price they are charging it is a steal! $30 for a "express" mani which included everything I would want!  They even gave us free ice cream as well were leaving since it is a hot day out.  I highly suggest this nail salon!

This place is terrible.  The hostess was very rude.  The waiter was pretty nice however.  The food was awful and terribly overpriced.  We went when there were very few people there.  The manager fell all over himself trying to make a nearby party welcome while totally ignoring us.  What a disappointment.  AVOID AVOID AVOID

We came in for rice bowls and love the simplicity of the menu and kind service. Food came quickly and the entire restaurant is immaculately clean. Nice seating options and calm decor. Food tastes great and was just enough for an early brunch meal.

I went to The Honu with a few friends on a Sunday recently for brunch. The atmosphere was nice. The house was really cute. The food and drinks were great. I had the mimosa flight, which comes with three glasses of champagne and mango, orange and pineapple juice. We shared the tuna poke as an appetizer, which I've been dreaming about since. The tuna was so fresh and tender. I had the breakfast tacos for my meal, and they were solid. Our server was attentive, but the only reason I didn't give this place five stars was for how long it took to get our food. It wasn't very busy, and I want to say it was close to 45 minutes from ordering by the time we got our entrees. We weren't in a rush, but it was definitely long. Overall, I will definitely go back!

This is officially the best restaurant in South Philadelphia now and incredibly affordable.  I took my Anglo-Saxon family there and the food was astounding.  The service is very slow, so when you go, do not be in a rush.  The food is made to order and the definition of delectable.  Everything on the menu was amazing.  They go out of their way to create make each order designed to share.  It takes them a lot more time but if you love food, it is worth the wait.  BYOB, cash only.  They should remove the T.V., and play music, those are my only two suggestions.  The prices here will inevitably go up very soon, and still it would be worth it.  Thanks for providing South Philadelphia with high-quality food, we need it.  I felt like I ate food in someone's family kitchen.  Each dish was presented and prepared with a lot of love.

Fantastique!  Revolucion has a bazillion things going for it.  It's in Fountain Square.  It's owned and operated by the owners of Radio Radio, a Fountain Square institution.  It's got a tiki bar!  I've actually been recommending it to others before I had even been there.  That's how confident I was that it would rock.  And upon my first visit, I was not disappointed.  I had the fish tacos and a Mexican beer.  The fish tacos were super tasty, filling and a mere $6!  I am anxious to try the margaritas.  There's no doubt I will be here lots!

Kimpton Hotels are among my favorite hotels.

They are trendy and modern. The decor is beautiful. I love that they are pet friendly and don't charge extra fees. They have peanut butter flavored treats for your pet at check-in . They can also provide you with a loaner pet bed, water bowl, mat and even food if you forget. 

The rooms are clean and airy. Each room comes with a free yoga mat and umbrella. You can also borrow a bike to ride around the city. 

The staff are friendly and make sure you feel welcomed. A complimentary happy hour is hosted everyday from 5-6pm and free coffee and tea in the morning. 

Located in Old City across from Independence Hall. 

There are a lot of homeless in that area so definitely use caution. When we were walking a homeless man came charging towards us which was scary. He was definitely high and when we told him to stop and leave us alone he cursed at us and called us dirty B's. Luckily we were ok and we were able to continue walking.

Love this place! The service is great and the food is delicious! I tried the mofongo con camarones and it was fantastic. Chef Carlos does a great job with the food he makes. Also tried their pastrami sandwich (just like they make it in Puerto Rico!) and their beef empanadas! And, they do local delivery on orders of $20 or more!?

Service was great. I had the scallops grilled with a crab cake appetizer. My meal was very good. My wife had the shrimp tacos which she says were also very good.  Side dishes were good and seasoned well.

Nice dinner on recent Monday night.  Had a nice business dinner on a recent Monday evening.  Love the grilled octopus salad appetizer.  Salmon was also excellent.  Service was professional.  Heavily Italian wine list could use some helpful explanations for those not so expert in wines from this country.

Wow, what a gem.

My dad and I have birthdays very close to each other's, so we all went out to celebrate yesterday. Our server Duncan was very attentive. I settled on two small plates: the bacon-wrapped apricots (so good!) and escargot (a little gritty...). For my medium course, I had the sweet corn gnocchi, and creme brulee for dessert. Who'd've thought there'd be such a lovely place so close to where I live?

AMAZING food. Make sure you make a reservation for the weekends. This is a BYOB and the wait is worth it. Their pastas are sooooooooo good. I LOVE the gnocchi Fellini but I get it w/ Linguini. One plate of pasta will fill up two people w/ leftovers.

A true farm to table concept restaurant. And accordingly, the vegetables that we had were elegantly prepared and excellent. The meat entrées were a bit heavy-handed--too much sauce accompanied my pork chop, for example. But since this is only their second week, I anticipate some refinement with the proteins and their presentation. 

The space is still fantastic-some minor changes from how it was set up with Salt. In the end, definitely worth a try.

Stayed nearby for work at a hotel for about 2 months. Time was limited and laundry facilities were nonexistent. I took my laundry here and they took great care of it and folded it beautifully. It's the only place I'll use while here for business.

Overpriced and underwhelming.  Had the sausage/egg:cheese sandwich this morning on whole grain $4.89. Sausage was cold and the sandwich was about 1/2 the size of the picture on the menu. It comes on these large plates and it's just a embarrassing.  Husband had bacon/egg/cheese on brioche, $4.89 and his egg was cold and the entire sandwich was greasy.   I can get this kind of food at McDonalds for a fraction of the price.
While I was initially hesitant to do so, I decided to give another stylist at 18/8 a try. I'm glad I did. Paula was great and I am very happy with the end results. I will be a return customer!

I'm so glad I asked for recommendations on Facebook before our trip to St. Louis. I never would have found Ted Drewes on my own and we ended up going here twice in 12 hours (disclaimer: I'm 7 months pregnant but I probably would have gone twice even if I wasn't). 

I was a bit intimidated watching all of the regulars order their concretes with confidence and was nervous about holding up the line. The server behind the window couldn't have been more patient or kind and told me numerous times to take all the time I needed. He walked me through customer favorites and helped me make the perfect selection - a Reese's peanut butter cup concrete with banana. HELLO HEAVEN. My mouth is salivating just thinking about this custard.

Trust me, this place might be a little out of your way during your trip but I promise you won't be disappointed. Take the detour!
Such great food and bartender Joe is awesome!!!   Must is their She Crab Bisque. Makes you glow

I'm shocked to read that other people have had problems here, because this place has been nothing less than excellent every time I've been! Everything I've tried there I've really enjoyed. The cajun spiced catfish is by far my favorite! The wine list is good, though I've never tried anything else from the bar. The service is always attentive and even the chef comes to visit the table! Don't forget to get the apple lind betty for dessert, it's to die for!

Bartender Eric was kind and helpful in a very timely manner- he immediately greeted us and was happy to help. Very relaxed environment and strong drinks- what more can you ask for? Looking forward to stopping by again

Been here for a couple of times,Basic ambiance, basic menu,basic everything. I have just tried the Dosas, Guess that after Uduppi closed down, the best dosa's in this vicinity are now available here.I drive in from Central Philly to Bensalem just for the South Indian food
I tried the somosa's they were refried and not tasty at all, neither was the Chaat.
Loved the pastries ( All of them taste the same,Pinapple flavor) Reminded me about the pastries back home in India.
Picked up a packet of Pao (Mumbai's favorite street food Bun), as I make a mean Bhaji (The potato / Cabbage/Pea dish) they turned out really authentic.

This place had a long line, and we went on a Monday! Worth the wait, though. While there was parking behind the building we had to circle a few times bc it was still so busy!

While I don't have any other hot chicken to compare this to, I was impressed and found everything on my plate to be delicious. The brisket tacos were also very yummy! The sides weren't anything special.

After we ate we walked around this neighborhood, which was really fun.
We usually get takeout from here, so despite reviews saying the service was bad, it's worth doing takeout as the food is very good.

If you like liquid smoke ! ‍
Ok food, ok everything... there's better around that is forsure.

I really love German Bistro.  It has a great local restaurant feel!  Prices may seem high for dinner service upon first glance, but given the free beer and wine, indulge and it more than pays for itself!
I stopped by with my family for lunch buffet. They had a large selection of vegetarian items. We liked the food very much especially Punjabi kadi, Kheer and gulab jamun.

1. Best Tater-Tots EVER. (Seriously)
2. You can get St. Elmo Shrimp Cocktail here. (Yay!!)
3. Deep Fried Avocado!! (Yum!)
4. All Bathrooms are Gender Neutral. (Amazing!)

Great atmosphere. Park in the mall garage, no problem!, Burger was really tasty. Awesome Mac & Cheese. Good beer selection. Great service.

We had the Italian sausage sweet potato hash, the beef sweet potato hash and the Brie stuffed French toast. It was amazing and I am now swimming in a glorious food coma. I will come back here over and over again. It's packed and a little loud in here, but I would expect that from an awesome brunch place. Just be prepared to wait 15-20 mins for your table on a Saturday/Sunday.

This gym has everything from cardio, weights, ropes and a turf for agility exercises. The trainers are really nice and do a good job of motivating you. I have a few classes with Rich and Dan that are really good. Parking is relatively easy since it is located in the city. I've never had that much problem for parking, never had to park more than 2 blocks away. I really like this gym a lot.

Regarding the billing complaints on other reviews, I bought a year membership and prepaid for a cheaper deal. I haven't had any additional charges, but am not sure if the billing process might be different if I was month to month.

It has been a long time since I have left an establishment thinking the way I did last Wednesday. Not only did they discontinue 1/2 price Sushi night without telling us but the service was horrible! Their website still states 1/2 price sushi every Wednesday. Upon our arrival they failed to mention it was no longer going on, we just happened to overhear someone else. False advertising, update your website!! A few months prior when I came on a Wednesday night the place was packed, this time DEAD! Half their menu is wrong as well, and the staff is rude. Half of their beers they do not have, half of their desserts they do not have...update your menu! Our server was rude and insulting. Poor experience and we will never go back or recommend it!

Good Italian food here. Staff is always very friendly and attentive. Usually not too much of a wait even though I am very lazy about making reservations. The atmosphere is warm, with a family feel. Each meal I've gotten here has been great, portions are good, and prices are fair. Good location just off 202 on route 3 so not too much traffic getting in and out since it's on the edge of West Chester.

Great Shop.  Everyone does a great job there.  But you often have to wait a very long time unless you get there early.  Worth the wait (IMO) and I usually make a stop by P'unk burger or Chayya while I am waiting.  Great haircuts and good prices too.

this place is amazing. don't let the exterior fool you. 

i had lost all hope for any decent ethnic food in tucson after trying almost a couple dozen, but praise the lord, thanks to  sher-e-punjab, all faith is restored. 

my bf and i had a great dinner last night. so many flavors wrapped up in each dish, even the rice had clove in it!!! the chicken tikka masala was fantastic, creaming flavorful goodness, unlike the tomato paste over at Saffron. the chicken in the korma pretty much fell apart - so amazing. and my favorite dish that i always order at an Indian restaurant, the navraton koorma; it was bursting with flavor and tons of amazing veggies and paneer!!!

we ordered everything 'spicy' and it was absolutely perfect. they aren't scared to put heat in the food, which most places in tucson seem to go the opposite route to appease all of the old retirees i assume. 

thank you for one of the very few great dinners i've had in tucson!!!

I love this place more and more each time I come. 
Last night I tried, finally, one of the press boxes: the Montecito. 

OMG. Lobster, crab meat, bits of caviar with this lobster sauce and other gorgeous , colorful sauces in the plate. 

This is not even fine dining sushi. It's artwork you eat. 

Worth the waits though last night no one outside at 8 PM. Still about 10-15 before we got a table but who cares? 

This place is my favorite sushi in ALL of America.

I'm not sure I can write a review to adequately convey how truly excellent tonight's meal was! 

We started with the shrimp crepes and the gumbo, and had the black drum with shiitake mushroom sauce & my husband had the seafood "bayoubaisse".. Followed with a chocolate cake that was to die for, and some fantastic house made sorbet! 

Every course was perfect!  

The ambiance was lovely, the service outstanding!  Thank you David and Yana!

Thank goodness we discounted the negative reviews, despite how well written and convincing!

Going back tomorrow for brunch!

About 25 years ago, I hit Zocalo with one of my kitchen buds, Mark V. What an incredible experience - my first savory cocktail (Pablotini with a habanero), first true mole, first kiss in a life long love of chorizo. We knew Jackie and Lou professionally and from the restaurant school. Long before JG made the seen, they were rockin nuevo mex. For about 5 years, we would make a pilgrimmage and each time, introduce our friends to the incredible cuisine and dining experience. Then came kids...

Well, a quarter century later, son number two goes to Drexel and we've been to Zocalo two times in the last six months after a long, long hiatus. Good things - the prices are reasonable adn the service was fast. The carnitas and chicken were flavorable and juicy. the guac was better than average. As for the rest., the service was more or less indifferent, maybe because the servers are staring at an iPad while they wait on you. The food was ok, but has completely lost the balanced authenticity and innovativation sparkle that made this place stand out back in the day. 

I might go back for a taco and a beer at happy hour, otherwise ... no mas, no otra vez. Gordon Ramsey? Bring back Jackie and Lou!
Fantastic service, Delicious appetizers (char-grilled and Rockefeller), and excellent entrees (pompano & shrimp scampi).  Live music was delightful.  We will come back!!

Stopped for lunch. Harry's did not disappoint.  They're "wings" are pork shanks. .. Tender, no fat, amazing. With some Victory Oktoberfest (great beers on tap).  Plus bartender and servers customer service excellent.   Trained well.  Definitely recommend

Popped in here for a bite to eat during Paddy Fest and we definitely stumbled upon a treat! The place is definitely upscale so a good choice for a romantic dinner, special occasion dinner, however they do have a full liquor bar and raw bar that is a little more relaxed. They do have live entertainment, however when we were there is was very loud due to march madness and other festivities happening.  We sat at the raw bar to have a snack while we tried to kill some time waiting for a show we were attending down the street. We had the blue point oysters and the beef carpaccio that comes with a side of an arugula salad. It was sooo fresh and sooo good! Highly recommend stopping in to have a bite if you are in the area- and the oysters are to die for!  They were so clean, and fresh- and they also give you these cute little bottles of Tabasco! Be aware a dozen blue point oysters will run you about $36, but it is totally worth it!

Absolute scam, do not purchase a coupon of any kind for this company, they are never available, never call back and finally after a long run around they said that they no longer honor the coupons.  Save your self the time and bother and avoid "We Do That" because they obviously don't.

this place is in rittenhouse so obviously it's expensive, it has to be.  i like the chopped med salad, and thats what i normally order if i go there with friends. ( i'm trying to avoid mock meats in general, so i stay away from the burgers.)  the smoothie is great but i found out its like almost 400 calories, again i avoid it.  this place isn't for me like 90% of the time, but when you're hungover and want something greasy: stumble in and you'll leave happy.

Staff was very nice and helpful but we were extremely disappointed with the food. We ordered Eggplant Parmesan in which tasted like it came out of the frozen section from the grocery store and the spaghetti sauce tasted bitter as if they poured it out of the jar. We were totally disappoint in the food.

Holy cow. Best food experience in St Petersburg. Crazy fast getting our food, both appetizers and main meal. All members of our party remarked how good and how fast the service was.  Our waitress was Amber.  Highly recommend this place. Prices were very reasonable.

When I was planning my previous wedding, I was looking for a wedding band to match my custom Tacori engagement ring. This thing was pricey, and we had decided not to put a real centre stone in it right away to save money for our honey moon. I went in to Michael Hill one day to scope out bands because I had never been in before. I was greeted immediately and asked if I needed anything. I explained what I was looking for, and she directed me to the appropriate areas. She complimented my ring, and asked if she could see it. I held up my hand, and she said it looked like it needed cleaning. I was aware, and she offered to do it. I was going to take it to my usual jeweler, Crowley's, but I figured why not? When she brought it back, it didn't look any cleaner, and she said, "The side stones are very nice, but were you aware the centre is fake?" I was appalled. Did she just take my ring to investigate my stones? I stiffly replied that yes, I knew, and that there was nothing there I liked, which was the truth. It's an average store, with another branch in WEM just like it. Not recommended.

This place is clean, the food is yummy and the service is friendly, prompt and attentive. They had some pretty amazing drink specials as well as food specials for happy hour. A huge, very open bar allows you to see the whole room from wherever you're sitting. The bartender and food server were both extremely pleasant and friendly. (Just an FYI that the food and the drinks are rung up separately. There is a bill for each one.)They both waited and kept checking on us before we were ready to give them an order. My French martinis were perfectly made and my burger was cooked the way I asked. Will definitely be back!

Very good for breakfast. The portions are huge. Our server Frank was very attentive and made sure everything was great. The manager Tim came over and we ask if we needed something cooked special for allergy reasons and he said yes they can accommodate for that, just let the server know when ordering. Coffee is very good and my wife had the tea and it was also good.
Generally a good little place. In an area with so much good pizza, they will struggle to sell a lot of pizza. State of the art interior with decent food

Bummed to see a few only OK reviews for this place! We love it. My opinion: best all around Mexican BBQ in Goleta- better than Chicken Ranch, MUCH better than Pollofino. I recommend getting the special burrito, wet; both green and red sauces are good, but I prefer red. The combo meal satisfies too. Well-seasoned tri-tip (occasionally a bit tough) and chicken. I really like their salsa bar, but the salsas they have mostly aren't chip-dipping salsas like I think many people expect (they're primarily chili-based taco and burrito salsas; not tomato-based chip salsas). But get a couple of each and pour em over the wet burrito. I can't attest to the tacos, but my partner's had them and thinks they're solid, but not Lily's-level great.

I've been here twice. Here's how it went:
Happy Hour: crowded. slow service. but fries were yum diddly delicious. we got every single french fry offered. cheese did the weird gross thing when it gets cold and congeals. in like 2 minutes. that sucked. 

Random Friday night at 9pm: loud-ass music could barely make conversation which is weird because there were like 10 people in the bar, clearly not there to start a dance party. One waiter. So service was slow. Waiter tried to make up for it by being good looking.

Was expecting a lower priced menu but quickly realized the potential of high quality food and service. Food took a while to arrive but when it did it was HOT and fresh. Couple with no alcohol can expect to spend  $45.00 or so.

I have been going to this dive bar for years. Jonny's has a great happy hour everyday and it's very laid back. The food is always on point though. You may think that a dive like this wouldn't have the best options but you are wrong my friend. They make all of their dough from scratch and their naked wings keep me coming back every time. Their Jon's salad with grilled chicken is also a staple of mine along with their pizza.
They also offer games such as trivia and even bingo. They are all free to play and you win some great stuff like gift certificates and even 1 cent pitchers of beer! Can't go wrong with that. 
It is a smoking bar so be aware of that and it gets pretty bad when they are busy. It does get  crowded on game days or nights. Overall it's a great place to grab a few cheap beers with friends and a half-price pizza (did I mention they have 1/2 off pizza on certain days?)
Pie was good but the service was terrible. Don't come here for lunch because you'll be waiting for about 30 minutes or more waiting to be seated.

Finally an authentic Mexican taqueria! You know you're in the right place when it's packed with the locals. Hard to get a table on the weekends. Menu is small, prices are average, the tacos are packed with meat, but the star here are the handmade corn tortillas. Walking into this place I felt like I was back in Mexico visiting family. I would've given them 5 stars but one of the ladies there was rude when I asked for a fork. She said,"they're tacos. You don't eat them with a fork." Well duh, but I use it to pick up all the meat that spills out of the taco. Whatever. Not a fancy place but food is good.

I came here to have my hair done in an updo for a wedding.  Kadi was very nice and she did an amazing job with my long, thick, and typically unmanageable curly hair.  The facility itself has a great design with high ceilings and it was a pretty relaxing environment.  I don't do the salon thing very often but the price for what I had done was pretty comparable to what I saw advertised at other places in Manayunk.

My only hesitation to write this review is that it's almost trendy to review Tria, but the biz shouldn't be punished for it... 

My mistake is I passed by this place so many times thinking I should stop in, especially since it's packed, but figured the alcohol would be overpriced and food would be an expensive art project, at best. I was wrong. 

Rarely do you stop at a place like this. I've been twice and both visits were everything I'd want for a nice, casual dining experience. The first time I went we were the only ones outside (it looked like it was going to rain... and it did). The servers offered to reseat us immediately but we actually opted to sit outside and watch the rain. Everything was covered so it wasn't like our server got drenched coming to our table. I had a salmon sandwich, she had a salad and we shared a cheese plate. Everything was portioned and presented very well. The wine and beer they recommend went with the lunch nicely - we had a great time, so we came back a month later. This visit was equally enjoyable. We sat at the sleek bar for a drink before being shown to our table. I feel this spot is the perfect W. Washington Square casual experience coupled with it's nearby neighbor Varga for the rowdier experience.

Nice little place for lunch.. had the Ruben wife had the egg salad and a cup of chicken tortilla soup.. I also had an Americano coffee.. we took some pastries to go and had them later. I had the pumpkin cream cheese muffin she had a cake shot. All was very good..
You have got to try the "Beam Me Up Scottie"...a decadent chocolate snoball filled with fresh, hand-made peanut butter cheesecake. It's out of this world!
Been over an hour and still no delivery. Called them and they said they already came by. Clearly they had not. I definitely wouldn't try them again.

Not that I would do this to myself, but some people like this sort of thing: 
$1 pitcher of Natty Light on Mondays!

Tons of drink specials and happy hour for hookah!  They even had a promo where you guess the special blend and get $5 off.  I would tell you what it is, but the guy would probably hurt me.  

Very cool set up and décor.  I am definitely visiting them again the next time I am in Reno.

This place was really quaint however the food was far from first class. The toast was cold, the milk was warm, the pancakes looked barely cooked. The waitress spilled milk on the table and my phone and didn't even acknowledge it.

The best Vietnamese food by far compared to the typical Vietnamese food found on Washington Ave.  I recommend the spring rolls and the vermicelli with grilled pork.  There are also vegan options as well.

I really enjoyed this place! Half of our party was late for our reservation, but we were still seated right away, and brought drinks and a snack we didn't even ask for. The wait staff is excellent and timely. If I could complain I would say the appetizers took a little longer than I would have hoped for, but it only built up my appetite even more, which was well worth the wait. Food and drinks were very good and filling. Price is reasonable; worth it. The atmosphere and crowd varies from couples, to families to parties. They have a Bloody Mary bar which was fun! Funky little place!

I'm not sure if its just me, but I just wasn't impressed with Edison's.  

I grew up in a time when arcades were fantastic worlds of video gaming heaven.  Games everywhere, one quarter for the older games, two quarters for the classics, and three for the new games.   Ski ball paid out tickets that would get you cheap prizes, but you could walk out of a night at the arcade with at least a decent sized teddy bear or a bag of whoopee cushions and fake barf.  

All that in mind, walking into a place that touts an "arcade" where a good portion of the games are designed to keep the toddlers happy while the big kids played laser tag, it was disappointing.  I took my 2 year old nephew to a whack a mole style game and I swear to God I hit every damned shark that popped up, giving us a score of 43 and walked away with 2 tickets.  That's BS folks.  B to the S.  

Other games do pay out better, but this arcade is nothing more than a mix of keep the younger kids busy type money pits and false hope "cut the string for the iPad" or other versions of the "crane" games that one might end up putting $20 into just to get a damned stuffed bear.  

I didn't have a chance to do the laser tag, so I could be missing quite a bit there.  Actually, the kids running around the place did seem to be having a good time.  I just cannot figure out why anyone would go there for anything other than the laser tag.  Bowling looked like any other bowling alley but for prices that aren't even worth spending.  SIUE is just up the road and about half the price.  

In all, if you have kids, I'm sure Edison's is going to end up on your list of places to go at some point or another, I just would highly encourage you to find a different option.  The games are over priced, with very little reward, and the pizza was good but nothing special.

The takoyaki balls were one of my food adventures for the summer.  I first tried them in June and I loved them.  Went back in July with my wife and I continued to love them.  Went back a few days ago and probably had the best takoyaki in 3 visits.  I liked them all.  The octupus, spicey shrimp and the sweet and sour were my favorites.  The crab c ake and the barbecue were also done well.  I think the chef- owner works hard to please his customers.  His wife is very friendly, easy going and aims to please.
We also tried the yakosobi noodles, which were good.  The Japanese potato salad was very good.
I think it is an interesting place, small and quaint.  The food is very different from any other restaurant.  
Be adventuresome and take a trip to the streets of Japan.

5 STAR FOOD! 
For sure one of if not the best place to get a sandwich on the beach anywhere between St Pete Beach & Clearwater Beach. All orders cooked to order. Super Size, gourmet servings and great very friendly service from the owner. Artison sandwiches for the price of Subway. Great cook with well seasoned sauces and dips usually. I always go for the daily special. Today was 3 Shrimp taco's for $6.00 The shrimp were cooked perfectly and served on fresh corn tortillas with a Kiwi sauce with some fresh peppers. Just enough spice and fruit with the shrimp. DELICIOUS. I could have had 6 they were so good. Only drawback is this place is walk up with only bench seating outside. Not a problem given the food quality for me personally but some may p[refer to sit at a table. It's on the bench or to go. A great place if you are staying at one of the local hotel to walk to. I hear they will start delivering soon. This is a local favorite for me.
The only reason I did not give 5 stars overall as the seating may be an issue for some.
Food was ok but service was terrible. Management team needs a class on conflict resolution and customer service...

As a property manger I have used Alpine consistently for the last 4 almost 5 years for my re-keys and lock outs.  The quality and  continuity of their service is unparalleled.  I probably should admit this but after locking my keys in my car at a showing at the back of Cold Springs....on a Friday late in the afternoon the guys at Alpine came to my rescue.  I cant imagine using another locksmith.  They are great with my clients and exhibit professionalism beyond compare at evictions.  They are  my go to and will remain such for years to come.

These guys are the best!  I was limited to one particular day for my move, and even though G&G was already booked for that day, they told me they would make time for me.  And they did - they even showed up over an hour early after calling to make sure that would be okay!  Once there, they got right to work and worked quicker than any other moving company I've used.  They were incredibly careful with everything I owned and there were no damages or breakages.  They even put moving blankets down on the floors to keep them clean, and moved them around as they needed to use different entryways.  

They price by the job instead of by the hour, and the actual price at the end of the job was exactly as they quoted, no surprises.  I found and used a great Living Social deal for them, but even without that savings their price came in way lower than a lot of the larger companies that I got quotes from.  And since they're local, they knew their way around and I didn't have to worry about planning out the best truck route to the new place.

Overall, a super friendly and professional local, family-owned business that I couldn't recommend more!  Look out for more Living Social deals over the next year.

The Best Pizza in Tampa . The food is delicious and I love the New York decor . 
The Da' Bronx pie was awesome , salads and wings too . 
If you ever need a bite to eat in channelside . This is the place to visit . 
Your kids will love it and so will the rest of the family . I'm writing this review and getting hungry thinking about it . Thanks for the great service too.

Quick Read: Aside from the parking and occasional crowds -- this place is fantastic.

Thankfully, Buddy Brew is expanding -- a move that I hope will relieve some of the terrible parking issues. This place is a must-try in Tampa. The baristas are friendly, knowledgable, and efficient. The breakfast and lunch options are solidly tasty. The coffee is roasted with a level of care that I'm glad to see in Tampa. One of my absolute favorite places on the planet.

Before I start my review I had to laugh at the yelper who was bugged this restaurant did not serve their tacos with lettuce, tomatoes, cheese, and sour cream.   Obviously they have no idea that authentic tacos come with two corn tortillas, the protein, diced white onions, and cilantro.  Lol.  Moving on.....

As I loosen my belt after enjoying my to go meal from this spot. I happily give five stars.  Apologies in advance for no photos - I started eating standing up and forgot about photos before half the meal was gone.  I ordered a chorizo burrito and al pastor taco to go.   The burrito was huge and filled with savory chorizo, refried beans, rice, and topped with a scattering of tomato and a few strands of lettuce.  I opted for the spicy sauce on top. I think there was cheese sauce on there too.  It was great. Very flavorful. The rice and beans inside were a great addition. Being inside they mixed with the chorizo juices and were very good.  The taco was as I mentioned.  True to form, the al pastor had pineapple chunks in there too. Three of these alone would be a great meal in and of themselves.   I did not get to sample the guacamole or chips.  I'll be back however to dine in and I am expecting good eats.  

Very pleased. Service was quick, prices were decent, and the place was vibrant. Don't come expecting Taco Bell food and you'll be pleased.

My husband and I love Ponti's! We live in Conshy and make it to Ponti's a couple times each month. Everything we've had there is great - and all freshly prepared. Classic cheesesteaks are fabulous, and I love the buffalo bill sandwich too. Try the copy cat fries...you'll never be the same!

We went on a Tuesday evening and got right in.  Our service was fast and attentive.  We ordered Craig. Rangoon and it was good, but lacking in crab.  We also had the Vietnamese  spring rolls that were delicious.  For entrées we had General Wang and bankok Boom.  Both were awesome as we wanted them extra extra spicy and they supplied us with a spoon and some sombal oelek to add to it for our preferred spice.  A very good meal.

Hendricks is a must try in St.Louis. The meats,sauces,and sides are better than most barbecue places.Onion rings are huge and the coleslaw is tasty and finely shredded. Service is good and very friendly. Takes awhile to get the meal,but it gives you time to check out the unique decor.

Super chill local joint with excellent bar/casual food, a cool cocktail menu, and great bartenders.  They will take care of ya!  Exactly what I was looking for to enjoy a yummy lunch and just kick it in the Big Easy!

Second time to visit Mazarin in three years.  Three years ago it was great, including the breakfast.  

But this last visit, Dec 2016, not too good.  I never got an answer to three phone calls previous to the visit.  (Three different days and three different times of day) So, I emailed to request courtyard view.  My Superior bedroom was facing the courtyard but it did not view the courtyard.  I was put on the third floor which viewed  the top of a tarp that covered the courtyard during inclement weather.  Only the weather was not inclement ... I suppose they were too tired to remove tarp.  They are very busy. (Never got answer to email either)

We booked the room for two people and had to request two wash clothes each day since there were none.

The concierge never looked up from her PC to welcome guests and it would look better if she would smile. (She probably wasn't feeling well)

Doorman was great and the desk service was prompt.

The breakfast was not up to standard for a hotel of this price point.  It seemed cooked hours previously, then placed on steam trays.  Similar to what is served in La Quinta.  Eggs were scrambled and stiff, bacon was limp and chewy and all the breads were stale and cold.  Juice and coffee were fine.  We stayed three days but only ate breakfast there the first.  Even though breakfast cost was included in the room cost.

Hint to cooks: If you keep scrambled eggs on steam trays they continue to cook and become over done.  Also breads, bagels and croissants are baked fresh daily in the Quarter.  It would be good to serve it.

On the better side the rooms were very clean and when the drain in the shower was slow, leaving us standing in an inch of water, they sent maintenance man right away and repaired it.  Slept well every night

I am sorry but we will not be staying a third time and cannot recommend this hotel as a 4 or 5 star hotel.

Delicious food and friendly folks, no better combination ! John and I ordered 2 salads and the BiBimbap skillet to share. All food was fresh with lots of flavor. Crispy rice at bottom of skillet was divine. Definitely worth getting off interstate on road trip today a fabulous and healthy lunch.

We had the most perfect wedding, and it is all because we chose the most perfect venue!  When deciding on our venue, pretty much our only prospect was the Riviera Mansion.  Once I found out that they had the date we were hoping for, we booked it immediately without looking into any other venues.  Having never planned a wedding before, I was at first very overwhelmed with all of the details that are involved.  One of the best things about the Riviera Mansion is that they provide all tables and chairs, linens and everything else for the table, unless you want to rent your own.  They do all of the food and beverage and have a very extensive food and drink menu with any option you can imagine!  You can put together your perfect menu and package.  

We had our ceremony there as well, and it was so beautiful and convenient!  Our reception was flawless, and the food was absolutely amazing (our guests are still talking about the food!)  We danced all night until 11:30pm which is a much later last call time than most other venues and hotels.  

The very best part about the Riviera Mansion is the staff.  I cannot say enough good things about everyone that works there.  Breanna is the event coordinator and she was so thorough throughout the entire process!  She took time to meet with me several times and gave me tons of advice and was there all day long the day of the wedding making sure everything was perfect.  Eli, the food and beverage director was there the entire night and took care of everything!  He was so accommodating and made sure that we had everything we needed. Chef Harley and his team made the best food, and the servers and bartenders took care of us all night long and were so sweet to all of our guests.  They made the experience what it was and it is rare these days to find such impeccable service from start to finish, but we sure found it!

I would HIGHLY recommend the Riviera Mansion to anyone, and I plan on telling all of my engaged friends to seriously consider having it there.  Having been to many other weddings in Santa Barbara, I really do think that this is the best wedding venue in town.  It is so much more exclusive than having it at a hotel, and much more convenient than doing it at a private estate.  We had the entire mansion to ourselves all day long which was so helpful.  The guys have their own game room with pool tables and a TV so they can hang out and the bridal suite is upstairs and is so charming.  Everyone had the most wonderful time, and there is not one thing that I would change!

Take plenty of Sun Screen !!!  Really well organized and run. Not a bad seat no matter where you get a ticket. I recommend a top row of the reserve grandstand. It is nice because you can bring something to hang on the fense to shade your back after mid day. Plenty of food and drink available but you can bring your own drinks just no ice-chest/coolers. I took a shoulder bag cooler, an insulated lunch box that held 8 drinks and that was ok.  Expect to have your bag searched for guns and pepper spray, no problem with a pocket knife. First races are at 0800 gate opens at 0700. Last race at 1630. There is a free concert after the last race of yo chose to stay longer. We will be back next year for sure.

Went in looking for Pete's Wicked Strawberry Blonde today, came out with Lancaster Strawberry Wheat and a sense of purpose that went far beyond cracking open my newfangled bottle o' beer.  The employees (er, dudes) are friendly, savvy, encouraging and let me leave my groceries in an out of the way corner while browsing the wide  selection. Rarely does it make fiscal sense for me to put together a miscellaneous 6 pack but it's nice to have the option and makes a killer birthday present for adventurous beer lovin' pals. Also, there's often a grey cat crashed out on a high shelf or wandering around the store. Nothing says cozy like a sleeping kitty and a store full of beer.

This location is suffering and will undoubtedly come on the radar for improvement. Not only was customer service the furthest thing from any employees mind, the food was terrible. We attempted to go through the drive-thru. Sat there forever with no greeting or any sign of life from the speaker. The screen was blank. Thought maybe it was broken so we drove around. A few cars in front of us but no one moving so I went inside to order to-go. 2 people ahead of me. 5-6 minutes later someone came to take the 1st guys order but couldn't use the register. 2nd guy was in line for a refuns because he was double charged for an incorrect order. I ordered. 4 sandwiches, not a single one had the correct toppings. Burgers cold. Fish sandwich over cooked. Fries were cold and gross. We didnt even eat half our meal and threw it away. I would give negative stars if I could.
Hands down the best snowballs in this city. I have been to every place in the city and Pandora's is the BEST!!!!

Got there at quarter to 3 and the restaurant closed at 3. Waited inside for ten minutes to be told we couldn't order anymore. Kind of annoying that I'd been standing there patiently for ten minutes instead of rudely just jumping in. I eventually was allowed to order a kid's grilled cheese which was huge and excellent. I really wanted a veggie burger but was told the kitchen was too backed up. It came with fries too and those were cooked really well. We shared onion rings and they were ridiculously good but you can't eat a whole order yourself. I feel like one order is good for four people to share. The bf got the tri tip (which is why we went there) and loved it. 

The reason for the three rating though is that the bathrooms were disgusting and the trash was overflowing from all the bins. 

Great live music plays and everyone who works there is super chill. Beautiful views on the drive up too!

Parking can be tricky but it's worth the walk.

A welcomed and long overdue addition to Bridesburg! Smokey Pint is truly one of a kind, and not just for the neighborhood, but the city. First, let's talk food. Specializing in BBQ, all the food is created by the Oink and Moo food truck team. SP is offering a solid selection of the trucks staples, from quesadillas, to sliders, tacos, mac & cheese, ribs, and more! And the brisket is to die for, a must try! Then comes the beer. You can choose from a selection of 6 rotating drafts, or 3 full fridges full of bottled and canned beer. Mix and match to create your own six pack, drink it in, or both. SP is a must go if you live in the neighborhood, and definitely worth the trip from the city!
The slowest at each stop in the drive thru. Fries soggy it was 630 they should have been fresh. Poor service. Like they had trouble counting at each stop too . Won't be back any time soon .

The car wash part is ok. The recent trend of an employee out there micromanaging which lane to go into to pay and "assisting" you in paying is annoying, but not a deal breaker. This day, we took my husbands work suv through, and followed it with the free vacuums. An employee came over with attitude telling my husband that he needed to clean this up, stating this was not in his job description, that he didn't come to his work making a mess, etc etc. You can see in the first photo i posted, the "mess" we made. We pulled the protective carpet out of the back, and the dirt of a landscaping truck made it to the black top on the way to being laid out and vacuumed. When he came over with the broom and dustpan telling us that we were now going to sweep this up, and after some rude exchange of words on his part, we asked to speak to his manager. He replied that he already told her and she saw it too and told him to come over. We said go get her. Perhaps this guy has a problem with gender differentiation, but likely, he was just lying through his teeth and sent a male "manager" over to back him up. He asked "you want to know why we keep this cean? because a lot of expensive cars come through here and we like to keep it clean for them".


     Shucks, guess our 8 year old trailblazer work truck must not have been up to his par. He was not accommodating until we asked to speak to the owner, he had no contact information for the owner, but all of the sudden, wanted to know what our complaint was, how he could help, and informed us we could call back tomorrow and speak to justin, who handles the complaints.


     The parking lot was filthy, obviously it is rarely if ever swept up or cared for. There was not one piece of trash, nor none earth debris of any sort, from us or around us. Of all the mess, all the trash on the ground, in that lot, not one other person was verbally reprimanded. This was just a strange power trip. There is never any excuse for an employee to cause such a scene, nor to drag it out as far as to bring over a dustpan and brush over while demanding and standing there, watching, and waiting for the customers to sweep up dirt from pavement. A bunch of my friends used to work at a car wash up in bucks. They were sick none stop in the winter due to being soaking wet and in the cold. These guys have it easy, and apparently have way too much free time on their hands there. The owners got to be saving $100 an hour in labor, he should make sure the few employees he does have, can handle customer service appropriately. Others complain they were scorned for being dissatisfied with the results and wanting to go through again for free. take the ten cent loss and keep the customer happy. Id bet anything that small bit of dirt is still there, and that no one ever saw it as any inconvenience to begin with.

I bought two Voice Daily Deals for We Do That. Three hours of house-cleaning services. The first Saturday we had scheduled (which was in May), they didn't show up, and I sat around all day waiting for them. Boo-hiss! When I called Monday, they said I wasn't on the schedule.

We rescheduleld for another Saturday (in June). They called three times that morning to confirm the appointment. Why do you have to do that?

Three people came for one hour. They cleaned two floors.

When it was time for them to leave, they told me there was a $15 upcharge for them to come on Saturday, because people "volunteer" to work on Saturday. Surprise!!

Upon inspection, I found dust absolutely everywhere. They didn't even mop the kitchen floor -- just swept it. And they didn't vacuum the steps to the second floor.

With that deceit and poor performance, I chose to not use my second coupon.

So I lost on this one.

And I'll be wary of future coupons related to services. And certainly wouldn't buy two!!

The bustling hipster joint itself is very cool! The service was 100% on point! Even with all the tables being full there were seats at the bar so we didn't have to wait at all. The cooks are all out in the open so we watched them after we ordered our food. 

The only big complaint I have was the Bloody Mary. It was the one with the raw oyster in it. Oyster was delicious but the drink itself was God awful. Maybe bc I'm used to thicker tomato based bloody Mary's where this one was a carbonated, citrusy beverage. I wasted $10 bc I couldn't even tolerate choking it down. 

Better notes...the food:)
Glazed bacon... Very fatty buuuut thick cuts and the parts we could eat were amazing. 

Pistachio donuts served with a light crème and a few small orange slices were so delicious! They literally melted in your mouth. 

The liege waffle: my favorite item we ordered! Very light and fluffy. Served with whatever syrup was not too sweet and not drenched either. Served with 2 perfectly crunchy pieces of bacon and nuts sprinkled on top of the waffle. So good!

The Viking patti melt: perfectly cooked(a little pink inside) served with crispy French fries. The one and only complaint I had about this was the salt. They add salt onto the patti before they cook it... I would ask them to hold the salt if you decide to order this. I was on the verge of a stomach ache after eating 2 bites of this.

5 hours later... My stomach has been kind of messed up all day. Not sick but just unsettled. I'm on a plane right now so hoping nothing happens. My boyfriend just informed me that he's been stuck in the bathroom for the past 30 minutes. We had high hopes for this place:/
Great Thai / Malay / Indo food. Excellent service and humorous workers. The food never fails!

This is the best BBQ place in these parts! The sandwiches, the brisket and the ribs are amazing! Side are so good, beans and corn bread you can not go wrong. The special sandwich of brisket, smoked pork and smoked turkey with smoked cheese on top might be the best sando in Alberta!

I used to go to elavation. I really liked the grass fed burger, fries, and shakes. But over time, this place has turned into a dirty, greasy, grimy, place. 

You have to wonder, if a place doesn't keep the front of the house clean, what does the back look like. I'm going to stick with shake shack for my burger needs. EB needs to clean house.

Don't work here either. The people are ignorant.

Two stars only because the server did his best. Ordered the mushroom Swiss burger... Asked for it medium and it came out well done. Server was great- he took it back and brought me a new burger. The meat tasted over processed/ground. Half the burger was cooked medium and the other half well done... They must be having a problem with their grill because my friends bison burger was the same.

I love this place. Everthing I've tried there has been so good. I love the food, ambiance and cooks. The hibachi chefs include everyone in the fun. The only complaint I have is they are not opened early enough for us to go during week. If they were open earlier than  4:30 during week we would go more often.
Monday night (Wing nights 12 wings for $4 is worth it even though they only have BBQ, mild and hot).  Pretty terrible staff when it comes to attentiveness but I guess it's what you pay for.

Taste of the basil fried rice and chicken was good.  However, meal predominantly rice with very little chicken or vegetables.  Would have rather spent $10 at Ghengis Grill and gotten a lot more good for my money.

Probably not going back as it wasn't worth $10.  Convenient and quick service for those that might like it, though.
The food here is ok.  Nothing special. I think I like Dairy Queen hot dogs better but a fun place to take someone to that wants just a simple meal with some neat nostalgia.

This truck came to my place of work and I am so glad. The mustard bbq sauce is great and goes great with the sausage which was cooked with a great "crust" and flavor. The owner is very personable and makes all of his own sauces which are all delicious. 
Thanks and keep it up!

Although the food is great, this place gets 1 star because of the incredibly long wait and disorganization of the hostesses. There has to be a better system to get people in the door. It's just ridiculous. After over 2 hours in line,  we get to the door, just to have our name taken to be put on a list and told we have an additional hour and a half wait (ended up being less than an hour). Do better!

Definitely go here! The atmosphere is great. Just a really good vibe when you walk in the reallllly fancy doors! Everyone was happy & welcoming. The decor inside is so nice! I love the rustic but also slightly modern feel. Food was good! My friend & I had salads but the portions were perfect & everything was fresh. We will definitely be back & my fiancé is excited to give Bernie's a try too! Can't wait to try some of their other food. So excited to have a new place to go to in Hatboro!

I visited this yummy place last weekend and still can't get the food off my mind, so I thought it was necessary to share my love of PP's food!! My family and I arrived pretty early, around 8am, on a Saturday, with two kids in tow. There was a little bit of a line but it moved along quickly and I'd say the wait was about 15 minutes long to get in. Once we got in, we were taken care of quickly by very kind servers. I ordered the Grill Cook's Medley and it was DIVINE!! The potatoes were fried up nice and crisp with a little bit of soft potato layered within the crust and covered in grilled veggies and meat. I ordered the meal with a side of pancakes and those were simply delicious-fluffy and sweet!! I'd wait an hour to get into here!!!!

Fantastic restaurant concept. Good cheap food fast. Fresh, better than average ingredients. Indie background music. No complaints. 
This type of pizza is better when consumed immediately. Take out degrades rapidly.
The shrimp and grits for breakfast were outstanding -- just sad I discovered them on my last day in town.

They don't just have great cookies, cupcakes, and puddings! I ordered a salted caramel cake for a birthday party, and it was amazing - four layers of moist cake with caramel buttercream between each layer. I checked before I ordered to make sure that the icing would be from real ingredients. Indeed - it's made from butter and sugar, and it tastes like it. The cake was both elegant and delicious, a rare combination.

I had the worst customer service last evening. My boyfriend and I went into this gas station for some beer and waited at the counter for 10-15 minutes because they were having a shift change. There's nothing wrong with that, but the lady at the front desk didn't have to be so Snyde about it. Once he waited for so long he came back out to the car and I went in and basically yelled hello across the counter and then was finally checked out, and the lady who rang everything out was rude the whole time because she didn't care, and the other employees were laughing the whole time. Terrible, ignorant customer service

DELICIOUS.  My friend and I stopped here last night after a concert at festival pier. We were both starving so we ordered the bacon grease popped popcorn before our waiter even said hello. The waiter was awesome, friendly and very attentive. The popcorn was so incredibly delicious seasoned perfectly with cayenne and paprika type spices. I cannot wait to eat it again!!!! 

I got the burger and fries,  both so good. The burger was juciy, definitely better than your average. It can definitely compete with fountain porter and silk city.

My friend got the fried chicken, mac and cheese and a biscuit.  The biscuit was huge and incredibly good. Moist, dense and perfect flavor.  Not too floury or salty.  The mac and cheese was soooo good. I usually do not like mac and cheese unless it is homemade at restaurants because it just tastes flavorless and salty. But this mac and cheese was definitely homemade and it was delicious, there was so much cheese and it had a delicious crust on top.
 
 basically, I cannot wait to go back again this place was so great.

I have eaten here many times.... the food is fantastic, the atmosphere is cool and the owner is Very personable !!!
I always recommend them ..

Much love for this place! So why only 4 stars? Well, the chairs can be improved....that story at the end. 
Gabe and I went here at his suggestion for his "better late than never" birthday dinner. One of the few times I'm allowed to pick up the tab ;)
He opted for beer and I opted for wine. Both enjoyable. He got the special which was some kind of sweet and spicy fried chicken. I got the shrimp and grits. The portions were small for those used to large meals but for us, it was perfect. Left room for more beer later. 
Atmosphere was dark and cozy. Everyone seemed to be enjoying themselves. Wait staff was friendly and efficient. Made reservations, arrived early and seated immediately. 
So about those chairs.... They're super cute but as I leaned over to grabbed my card that leaped off the table, I went down sloooowly. It was funny actually. A manager ran up to see if I was ok. Between my giggles, I told her "yes". Glad it wasn't a first date lol. 
So was it the wine that caused my graceful descend or the unsteady chair? Let's just say, not 5 mins later, a man at another table fell too....hahaha! I'm blaming the chairs.

Trendy but not snobbish, for people who know what they want.  I really love the touches from the tables, to the bathrooms, ability to fit everyone in to such a small space.  It's really cozy place to get drinks and food.

Woodstock burger is good.  Sweet potato fries were soft, and not crispy the way I like them.  Peanut butter dessert was good, but not life changing.  Just really liked the ambiance

Super busy at 4 PM, so.. you'll likely be waiting in line during peak hours.

Great thai food for a good price. I love the small cozy atmosphere and the service is good.  The spring rolls and veggie rolls are delicious.  I like the salmon with apricot sauce, the drunked noodles and the chicken is tender in all the dishes.  My favorite though is always getting the whole fish--delish!

So I am going to come clean here up front.  I love this place.  I love the food, the casual atmosphere and the staff is professional and welcoming.  
They are adjacent to my hotel every time I come to NOLA so I am here at least once per visit.  
I wanted to step outside my comfort zone and try something else today for a late lunch but when I sat at the bar, ordered a glass of wine and was given the menu- I didnt see what I wanted ( I had seen it on the lunch menu).  I wanted oysters, as in welcome to NOLA - oysters.  They would not serve them at the bar so I drank my wine and left. 
Here I am back at LUKE for my third meal this week.  And I got those oysters. 
I also got a warm welcome, great beer and hello - happy hour!  Thank you John Besh for doing what you do.  #superstar #kingofnola

Super disappointed.  Our waitress seemed high on something. She was sweet, but couldn't retain any information. We ordered a bottle of local wine and she served us wine from Argentina.   We weren't sure why she didn't open it in front of us, but trusted it was. After we asked to take photo of wine, because it was so delicious and wanted to support local wineries, she then realized she gave us the wrong kind. Had to adjust bill and just super bummed because she was so scattered. Soup was fantastic and the Buffalo Cauliflower was excellent. Just drug test before you hire.

I have been going to Deluxe and my stylist Mary for over 5 years now. I will never let any one other than Mary touch my hair. She is fabulous with color and cut. Mary has also styled my hair for formal events and I always receive tons of compliments. The only negative is that she is so good you have to book her months in advance for a weekend or evening appointment.

Love this little shop so much for so many reasons. First off, whenever I'm on my way to Sweet Divas, I can smell the spices wafting from this little, inviting shop. Second, they have such a large range of spices that you can smell, taste a little, and purchase. Yes, there's a large overwhelming variety of spices, but fear not! Their knowledgeable staff is available and more than happy to assist you in finding the right spice you are looking for all your cooking needs. Over the years I've purchased many items from here and I can attest that they do last a long time (about a year, year and a half, including some stuff I use often!). I see all kind of specialty salts for example (onion salt, celery salt) as well as sugars and powders (lavender vanilla sugar, vanilla bean powder). Their products even seem to taste fresher (I can taste a difference between their cinnamon and nutmeg and what I can get at a dollar store, for example). The prices aren't too bad and they last long. My three bottles pictured cost about $19, but that will last a good year, so its worth it to me.

After walking by this restaurant since May, I finally made it inside for dinner. The inside doesn't evoke the same excitement as the badass neon sign outside. The food seemed to be more expensive than it should have been, and I didn't like how dark it was inside, even in the window seating area. The fries were pretty great, but my buffalo wings weren't super pleasant with the addition of cheese in the sauce. This place was just eh.
A 12 dollar burger and fries that were not even edible. Seriously, I used to enjoy this place but man has the quality taken a nose dive.

The tortilla soup had too much chicken. I know that may sound odd, but the chicken was a little dry and the shreds were a little too big, the broth was exceptional, I would drink a vat of that. 
The Quesadillas were stuffed, as in I wish I had bought one to split with my hubster. Wow, that was a lot of food. It was good. I picked a pork and steak, they tasted distinctly different. I like to add my own level of spice to things, so it was just right, there was good depth of flavor especially for the price point. 
The Mahi appetizer tacos were cute and tasted good. Next time we will order less though because we barely finished a quesadilla between the 2 of us.
This is an accessible establishment for both wheelchair or mobility scooter. You can easily enter, wait in line, order and pay.

This is one of the coolest places for a happy hour or a fun Saturday afternoon in Tampa.  Kind of a pain to take a left turn into of you're headed northbound on Dale Mabry, but otherwise, cute and friendly waitstaff who totally rock, and decent prices as well. Keep up the good work guys!

Just a quick review on the dessert spot we discovered this past weekend.  I had heard good things about Frost before, and didn't know there was a location on Oracle near where my wife and I do a lot of our Tucson shopping.  So when we had the opportunity to stop in, we took advantage.

The staff was helpful, greeting us as we walked in, and allowing us to sample freely until we made our decision.  My wife went with a lemon gelato, and I had a combination of black cherry and raspberry.  All three flavors were excellent, and we felt like it was a good value for the price.  Yes it is a bit more expensive than your typical scoop of ice cream, but the quality reflects that price, so we still feel like we got a good deal.

The only knock I have is on their drinks.  They have tea and cocoa listed on the menu, but the person who rang us up admitted they don't serve them anymore and should take them off.  I appreciated the honesty.

If I could give this place no stars I would. This hotel is dirty, the staff is rude, and I actually cried dealing with the front desk....horrible!!!!!!!!! Priceline will put you in this crappy place so beware
Finally got to check out Melt, and it certainly did not disappoint! We got our food quickly, everything was hot and fresh, and everything was so, so good! I'll definitely be back!
Great place with a friendly staff! They have the best hot chocolate ever! The Belgium one is to die for. Sometimes me and my husband drive 1 hour just to go there! 10 stars for them!

What an awesome place to see a show! My first show at marathon was a sold out James Bay show. The line went fast to get in, and it was very easy to get drinks. The bartenders are very friendly even during loud shows! 
The second show I saw was Jamie XX! Much different crowd than James Bay but an even better experience. It was the perfect venue for Jamie XX! Bathrooms were clean and the set up for the stage is perfect for viewing all around.
I won't skip an opportunity to see my favorite artists here.

Love this gym and love Renah as a trainer! She really pushes you to work your hardest and to become the best version of yourself. Not only does Renah care about the well being of her clients - she cares about community organizations as well and supports them regularly with fundraisers. This is a wonderful place!

We made reservations for the W Main Street location. The appetizer we ordered was okay... We ordered the veg samosa. We have definitely had better in Tiffin in Bryn Mawr, PA. 

However, we ordered the Chicken Tikka Masala and the Aloo Gonhi and they were very tasty. Although I asked for it to be a little spicy and it was not spicy at all. But still overall a great taste. 

We thought we had a great experience until we went to pay. We had a double take deal coupon from doubletakeoffers.com which was pay $15 for $30. So when we went to pay they were not really sure how this worked. The "MANAGER" wrote down the code and said she would process it. When she returned to our table we still owed too much when I asked what the original amount was compared to the balance she got very defensive and I tried to explain that the deal was 30$, the "MANAGER" said that I needed to calm down and she believed me. All I tried to do was show her the coupon so that she did not think we were trying to pull one over on her. She was not nice about it at all. She took the check back to fix and stated she would be right back, she had someone else bring us our corrected check. As we were walking out and passing her she ignored us until we were almost out the door, and then she decided to yell from inside the restaurant "have a great day"!!!  She was very unprofessional. I also heard her speaking about a "special non-alcoholic cocktail" she was going to make for a child at another table, she had mentioned that she just started doing this. I hope the owners are aware. 

Despite the "MANAGER", which I hope soon will have to take a managerial class, we would come back for the food again.

This place is amazing ! Will make you feel special and relaxed! It's very clean and the staff is very friendly polite and professional! Michele did my meni pedi and was very very good!  Great spot to come in with a friend. Will definitely go back!

The historic  appearance of the hotel in general, was fantastic.  Why only 3-Stars?  Well, our customer experience while checking in was very unorganized.  The staff was unhelpful.  There aren't many African Americans who stayed at this hotel, and the moment the guy at the front desk laid eyes on us, his attitude was curt, abrupt, unhelpful etc.  I felt as though others like me would have felt 80 years ago.  Months ago we booked a very nice room.  When we arrived, all this man could do was say, as he looked at his computer..I'm so sorry, over and over again.  When asked why he was apologizing so much, he said it was because this room wasn't reserved for us, despite the confirmation letter we received from them some time ago, and even presented to him!
I tried to tell him why we wanted this room, and he talked over me and simply walked away in mid-sentence.  As though I was invisible.  He finally got another employee to help him, and supposedly we got "the room, with a river view".  With no help, we dragged our luggage to our room, only to find out that it was substandard to my liking and expectation.  It was more me than husband, as we had just arrived from the airport, and he just wanted somewhere, anywhere to lay his head.  Half the time our key cards don't work, which means we have to spend our time waiting for an elevator to take us to the lobby to request a key card that works.  How inconvenient!   I am not crazy about the room.  Not crazy about the plumbing sounds coming from our bathroom late at night either.  Unfortunately there are no other hotels to make a new reservation at which means we  have to stay in room 1467  until May 17, 2013...  Mrs Perello wasnt happy about the poor service or the excuses they easily provided.  Nice hotel, horrible service.  We were'nt satisfied until one of the staff members responded to our email plea to them.


Much to my surprise, they did respond and were most helpful beyond our expectations.  Dave was the individual who directly assisted us.  He was personable, professional, realistic and helpful.

I am so happy that they turned this around for us.  On a few levels!
Service was excellent and food was very unique. Really enjoyed everything we ordered. Love the decor and ambience! Nice addition to city dining.

In between Murfreesboro and Gallatin Pike this little park in nestled in the 'burbs of East Nashville. It doesn't have anywhere for you to grill out so you have to bring your own, but there is a nice little section of benches and covered benched areas for a picnic, and lots of open grassy places for the same. 

That is if you beat the Frisbee players to it. That's what the majority of this park is: Frisbee players. I have seriously never seen so many. 

There's a baseball field that I can only assume little league games happen at, and perhaps the local schools use. There's lots of room for parking, but with it's primarily a big hill, so good luck with your sports on that thing. I love the nature trail, it reminds me of the ones where I went to college, trampled little dirt paths, signs, and all. I love this park.
Delicious food and great staff. Alicia was friendly, knowledgeable, and went out of her way to make my dining experience a great one.  I will definitely be back!!!
It is a chinese buffett.  Not great, not bad.  The stand out are the generals chicken (crunchy like I like it.), and the tempura coated chicken wings.  The people are really nice here though.
Stayed here 2 weeks ago and it was really great.  Would definitely recommend. Love the Wifi in the lobby and the computers. Would be nice to have free wifi in the rooms.

I really want to like this place.  This bike shop is the closest to my home and I've been there a handful of times with mixed results.

Prices seem to be set by whatever kind of mood the dude is in; sometimes I get a free headset tighten (see below), and sometimes its $30 for 10 min of work.

I'm taking a star off because they went after my nice vintage french headset with a pipe wrench, now its gouged forever :(
Great service, great food and great bar. I found the French 75 to be a great brunch drink similar to that of a Bloody Mary or mamosa, although totally different.
